article_content: Adolf Hitler's grand plans for the 'supercapital' of the Third Reich, which he intended to rename Germania, are detailed in a new exhibition. Staged in a vast Nazi bunker, 'The Myth of Germania: Vision and Crimes' features the 'Hall of the People', which was planned to be twice the size of St Peter's Basilica in Rome and accommodate 180,000 people. A giant map shows plans for a five-mile-long boulevard designed to be flanked by towering buildings celebrating Nazi prestige. The planned new city was envisioned to be the largest in the world, featuring a stadium (pictured), avenues and statues that Hitler proclaimed would last for 1,000 years. The planned new city was envisioned to be the largest in the world, with grand buildings, avenues, and statues that Hitler proclaimed would last for 1,000 years. However, due to the war, only huge street lights on an avenue leading to the Brandenburg Gate were realized from Hitler's grand plans for Berlin. The Berlin exhibition reveals that architect Albert Speer – who escaped the death penalty at the Nuremberg Trials after claiming not to know about the extermination of Jews – was instructed to use Jewish slave laborers. He ordered evictions in demolition zones to expedite construction after Germany's anticipated victory in the war. 'Germania' architect Albert Speer (left) was instructed by Hitler (right) to use Jewish slave laborers. Hitler's ambitious plans to rebuild Berlin on a monumental scale were never realized, yet the preparations included demolitions and the exploitation of slave labor. Curator Gernot Schaulinski stated: 'This exhibition is not about 'Germania' as a dictator's hobby. It's about the project's intentions, the underlying ideology, and the suffering it caused.' 'Aryan' residents, forcibly evicted, were intended to be relocated into 24,000 apartments previously inhabited by Berlin's Jewish population. Curator Gernot Schaulinski stated: 'This exhibition is not about 'Germania' as a dictator's hobby. It's about the project's intentions, the underlying ideology, and the suffering it caused.' The Berlin Underground association, which explores and opens Nazi-era bunkers and buildings for public viewing, organized this exhibition. It is currently staged within a vast Nazi-built bunker in Berlin's Wedding district, which has become a tourist attraction. To meet the demand for construction materials for 'Germania', Hitler, Speer, and SS military commander Heinrich Himmler agreed to utilize concentration camp inmates as forced labor. The SS constructed the world's largest brickworks in Oranienburg, a camp near Berlin, where numerous inmates were murdered or perished due to the harsh labor conditions.

article_content: (CNN) -- Goals rained down in the English Premier League on Saturday, but for once Manchester United played it safe to stay seven points clear at the top of the table. Alex Ferguson's team kept a clean sheet for the first time in six games, beating West Bromwich Albion 2-0 at home in a match that had been in danger of succumbing to the UK's recent wet weather. By contrast, second-place Manchester City scrambled a 4-3 win at Norwich, Tottenham came from behind to claim third with a 2-1 victory at Sunderland, and Arsenal moved to fifth after triumphing 7-3 at home to Newcastle. All eight EPL matches provided goals -- 35 in total -- with Stoke drawing 3-3 with Southampton, Wigan beating Aston Villa 3-0, Swansea winning 2-1 at Fulham, and Reading ending a long winless run by defeating West Ham 1-0. United edged a controversial seven-goal thriller against Newcastle on Wednesday, showing the defensive frailties that have plagued the 19-time English champions this season, but the return of Nemanja Vidic helped steady the side against a West Brom team that has dropped to seventh place. The visitors went behind in the ninth minute when Gareth McAuley deflected Ashley Young's cross past his own keeper -- former United player Ben Foster -- and substitute Robin van Persie wrapped it up at the end with a curling shot for his league-leading 14th goal this season. Ferguson was widely criticized for harassing match officials during the Newcastle match and for claiming that Van Persie "could have been killed" during the 1-1 draw with Swansea, but he kept his comments low-key this time. "The pitch was a problem for us with the way we pass the ball -- it slowed our game down a bit," said Ferguson, who turns 71 on Monday. "We did well in the first half, we dominated at times, but you must give credit to West Brom who had more of the game in the second half and were a threat with their crosses." "They had quite a bit of possession into the second period so we decided to bring Robin and Paul Scholes on just to settle us down a bit and they did that well." "It's a good result considering how heavy the pitch was -- that's two games in four days on it and it's not easy. The slowness of it killed our speed." Blog: Has Ferguson gone too far? West Brom boss Steve Clarke agreed with the officials' decision to go ahead with the match after a late inspection of the waterlogged pitch. "We used to play on pitches like that all the time. You don't look for games to be called off for no reason and there was no reason today," he said. Manchester City boss Roberto Mancini was not so happy after his defending champions bounced back from the 1-0 defeat by Sunderland. Recalled striker Edin Dzeko scored twice inside four minutes, but Norwich got back into the game after Samir Nasri was sent off just before halftime following an altercation with Sebastien Bassong. "Both players came forward with their heads, so if you are going to send off one, then you have to send off both, not only Samir," Mancini said. "I am disappointed with Samir, and he will pay his fine, but the decision was not correct." The Italian will go into the New Year trying to retrieve a sizable deficit, though City overhauled United's eight-point lead last season to win the club's first title since 1968. "It's not important to look at the table because it's not final but we need only to work, to win and then maybe we'll look again at the table in February," he said. Dzeko almost had a hat-trick, but his 67th-minute shot hit the post and went into the net off Norwich goalkeeper Mark Bunn for 4-2, which was ruled to be an own goal. Russell Martin netted his second on 75, but Norwich stayed 11th after a third successive defeat. Tottenham moved a point above London rivals Chelsea, who travel to sixth-place Everton on Sunday. Sunderland went ahead against the run of play as skipper John O'Shea scored his first goal for the club five minutes before halftime, but Carlos Cuellar headed into his own net after the break and Aaron Lennon's 51st-minute winner left Spurs six points behind City. However, Tottenham star Gareth Bale -- a reported target for Real Madrid in the January transfer window -- was frustrated after being booked for diving for the third time this season. "That's three times now I've been clipped and booked for no reason," said the Wales winger, who will miss Tuesday's clash with Reading following his fifth yellow card this season. "People keep saying I'm diving, but if there's contact it's not diving. Referees need to look more closely." Theo Walcott bolstered his claims for a regular starting place as a central striker with his second hat-trick this season in Arsenal's topsy-turvy win over 15th-place Newcastle, which put the London side two points behind Chelsea. The visitors leveled three times as Demba Ba netted twice to take his league tally to 13, but Walcott's treble was complemented by a late double from substitute forward Olivier Giroud after Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain and Lukas Podolski also scored. Walcott has yet to agree a new contract, and the England international will have no lack of interest from other clubs after taking his tally to 14 goals in all competitions this season -- only Van Persie has more with 17. Stoke stayed eighth after coming from 3-1 down against third-bottom Southampton, extending the club's unbeaten home record to nine matches thanks to substitute striker Cameron Jerome's spectacular late equalizer. Defender Matthew Upson had reduced the deficit to 3-2 before teammate Steven Nzonzi was sent off for a challenge on Jack Cork. Swansea moved up to ninth as Fulham's stand-in keeper David Stockdale gifted the visitors two goals -- the first to striker Danny Graham, playing in place of the Welsh club's top scorer Michu, and the second to Canadian midfielder Jonathan de Guzman. Bryan Ruiz pulled one back after Dimitar Berbatov hit the crossbar, and the Bulgarian had a late effort ruled out for offside as the London side ended the year just four points above the relegation zone in 14th place. Wigan moved out of the bottom three after handing fellow strugglers Aston Villa a third successive defeat that will increase the pressure on manager Paul Lambert after the 8-0 demolition by Chelsea and a 4-0 home loss to Spurs. Reading stayed second from bottom despite the promoted club winning for only the second time this season, thanks to a fifth-minute goal from Russia striker Pavel Pogrebnyak that extended 12th-place West Ham's winless run to four matches.

Gareen Aleeks Fargason taphoota jahaan keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf galchii hin galchiifne, tapha rooba dhihoo UK dandamachuu balaa keessa ture keessatti Weest Buroomwich Albiyoon 2-0n mo'atee mana isaatti. Faallaa kanaatiin, Maanchistar Siitii sadarkaa lammaffaa irra jiru Norwiichitti 4-3n injifannoo argate, Tottenhaam duubaan dhufuun Sanderlaanditti injifannoo 2-1 argachuun sadarkaa sadaffaa argate, Arsenaal ammoo Neewkaastiliif mana isaatti 7-3n injifannoo argachuun sadarkaa shanaffaa irraatti ol ce'e. Taphoonni EPL saddeenuu goolii galchan -- walumaagalatti 35 -- Istook Saawuthaampiteniin 3-3n qixa galan, Wiigan Aston Viilaa 3-0n mo'ate, Siwaansii Fulhaamiin 2-1n injifate, Riidiing ammoo Weest Haamiin 1-0n mo'achuun yeroo dheeraaf injifannoo dhabuu isaa xumure. Yuunaayitid Roobii darbe Neewkaastiliin tapha goolii torbaa kan mormii qabu tokkoon injifateera, kunis laafina ittisaa kan yeroo kana shaampiyonoota Ingilizii yeroo 19 ta'an rakkisaa ture agarsiiseera, garuu deebiin Neemanjaa Viidiich gareen Weest Buroom kan sadarkaa torbaffaatti gad bu'e tokko madaalchisuuf gargaareera. Daawwattoonni daqiiqaa saglaffaa keessatti duubatti deebi'an yeroo Gaareet Makaawlii kubbaa Ashilii Yaang keessaa darbanii eegaa isaanii darbee -- taphataa Yuunaayitid duraanii Been Fooster -- fi bakka bu'aa Roobiin van Persii dhuma irratti goolii 14ffaa liigii isaa kan yeroo kanaa kan isaan dursuuf kan marmaaqa qabu tokko galchuun xumuran. Fargason tapha Neewkaastil keessatti ogeessota taphaa dhiphisaa fi Van Persii "ajjeefamuu danda'a ture" jechuun tapha Siwaansii waliin 1-1n qixaa galan irratti bal'inaan qeebeffameera, garuu yeroo kana yaada isaa xiqqeessuun itti fufe. "Dirreen akkaataa itti kubbaa dabarbinuuf rakkoo ture -- tapha keenya xiqqoo suuta jedheera," jedhe Fargason, kan Wiixata guyyaa dhalootaa 71ffaa isaa kabaju. "Walakkaa jalqabaatti gaarii hojjenne, yeroo tokko tokkoo kan mo'anne, garuu Weest Buroom kan walakkaa lammaffaa keessatti tapha caalaa qabaatee fi kubbaa ol darbanii balaa turaniif galata kennuu qabdu." "Yeroo lammaffaa keessatti qabeenya hedduu qabu turan kanaafuu Roobiin fi Pooli Iskoolsi xiqqoo nu tasgabbeessuuf fiduu murteessine, isaanis gaarii hojjetan." "Dirreen baayee ulfaataa ta'uu isaa yaadaan qabachuun bu'aa gaariidha -- kun taphoota afur keessatti lama kan irratti taphatamee fi salphaa miti. Suuta deemuu isaa ariifannaa keenya ajjeese." Hoggantuun Weest Buroom Siitiiv Kilaarki murtoo ogeessota taphaa tapha itti fufuuf dirreen bishaaniin guutamee erga qoratamee booda murteessan waliin walii galeera. "Yeroo hundumaa dirree akkasii irratti taphachaa turre. Sababa malee taphoonni hafuuf hin barbaadan ture, har'as sababni hin jiru," jedhe. Hoggantuun Maanchistar Siitii Roobeertoo Maansiinii shaampiyonoonni isaanii kan ittisan Sunderland irraa 1-0n mo'amuu booda deebi'anii gammachuu hin qabne. Taphatichi deebi'ee kan waamame Ediin Dzeekoo daqiiqaa afur keessatti yeroo lama goolii galche, garuu Norwiich taphicha keessa deebi'e yeroo Samiir Nasrii walakkaa dura xiqqoo dura Sebaastiyan Basoong waliin walitti bu'iinsa booda ala ergame. "Taphataan lamaanuu mataa isaaniitiin gara fuulduraatti dhufan, kanaafuu yoo tokko ala ergituuf yoo taate, Samiir qofa osoo hin taane lamaanuu ala ergituu qabda," jedhe Maansiinii. "Samiiritti nan gaddeera, adabbii isaa ni kaffala, garuu murtichi sirrii hin turre." Italiyaanichi gara bara haaraatti deemuun hanqina guddaa deebisuuf yaalaa, garuu Siitiin bara darbe hogganaa qabxii saddeet Yuunaayitid irraa ol ce'uun erga 1968tti yeroo jalqabaaf waancaa kilabichaa injifateera. "Gabatee ilaaluun barbaachisaa miti sababiin isaas xumuraa miti garuu hojjechuu, injifachuu qofa barbaachisa, sana booda tarii Fulbaana keessa deebinee gabatee ilaalla," jedhe. Dzeekoo hat-triik galchuu dhihaatee ture, garuu kubbaan isaa daqiiqaa 67ffaa utubaa rukutee eegaa Norwiich Maark Baan 4-2n galchii ofii ta'ee galchii ofii galcheera. Raseel Maartiin 75 irratti lammaffaa isaa galcheera, garuu Norwiich mo'amuu sadii walitti aansuun booda sadarkaa 11ffaa irra turan. Tottenhaam Riivaalota Landan Cheelsii irraa qabxii tokkoon ol ce'eera, Cheelsiin Sanbata Guddaa gara Everton sadarkaa ja'affaa deema. Sanderlaand tapha irraa hafee dursaa kan ture yeroo jalqabaa dura daqiiqaa shan dura hogganaan Joon O'Sheey goolii isaa yeroo jalqabaaf kilabichaaf galcheera, garuu Kaarloos Kueelaar walakkaa booda mataa isaatiin galchii ofii galcheera, injifannoon Aaroon Lennoon daqiiqaa 51ffaa Siiparsi qabxii ja'aan Siitii duubaatti gateera. Haa ta'u malee, urjiin Tottenhaam Gaareet Beel -- kan gabaasa Real Madriditti gabaa jijjiirraa Amajjii keessatti barbaadamuuf -- yeroo sadaffaaf yeroo kana bu'aa malee kufuu isaatiin booda aaree jira. "Yeroo sadii amma bu'aa malee nan kufaa fi adabamaa jira," jedhe wiingariin Weels, kan Roobiin waliin walitti bu'iinsa Wiixataa dhabuuf ta'e sababiin isaas kaardii diimaa shanaffaa yeroo kanaa argateera. "Namoonni yeroo hundumaa nan kufaa jedhu, garuu yoo walitti bu'iinsi jiraate kufuu miti. Ogeessonni taphaa dhiyeessanii ilaaluu qabu." Te'oo Waalkoot yeroo kana tapha walakkaa irratti iddoo jalqabaa yeroo hundumaa argachuuf daa'imman isaa sadarkaa 15ffaa irra jiru Neewkaastiliin tapha injifannoo jeequmsaa qabu keessatti hat-triik lammaffaa isaa yeroo kanaa galchuun cimseera, kunis gareen Landan Cheelsii duuba qabxii lamaan akka hafu godheera. Daawwattoonni yeroo sadii qixa galan Dembaa Baa liigii isaa hanga 13tti ol guddisuuf yeroo lama goolii galcheera, garuu galchiin Waalkoot sadii bakka bu'aa fuulduraa Oliiviyeer Jiruud irraa yeroo boodaa yeroo lama galchiin, Aleeks Ookislaayd-Chemberleen fi Luukaas Podoolskii fi goolii galchuun guutameera. Waalkoot hanga ammaatti waliigaltee haaraa hin mallatteessine, taphatichis Ingilizii kilaboota biroo irraa fedhii dhabuu hin qabu yeroo kana taphoota hunda keessatti goolii 14tti ol guddisuun booda -- Vaani Persii qofatu 17n caalaa qaba. Istook Saawuthaampiten sadarkaa saddaffaa irraa gaditti irraa 3-1n duubatti deebi'uun booda sadarkaa saddeettaffaa irra turan, kunis galchii qixaa dhumaa taphataa bakka bu'aa Kaameroon Jeroomiin kan ajaa'ibsiisaa galchuun galchii galchii manaa kilabichaa taphoota sagaliif kan hin mo'amne dheereessuun. Ittisaan Maatiyuu Upson hanqina 3-2tti xiqqeessuun dura taphataan garee isaa Istiivin Nzoonzii Jaak Koork irratti dorgommii taasisuun ala ergamanii turan. Siwaansii gara sadarkaa saglaffaa ol ce'e yeroo eegaa Fulhaam kan bakka bu'aa Daaviid Istookdeeli daawwattootaaf goolii lama kenne -- jalqabaa taphataa fuulduraa Daanii Giraaham, kan bakka goolii galchaa olaanaa kilabii Weels Miichuu taphatutti, fi lammaffaa taphataa walakkaa Kanaadaa Joonataan de Guzmaanitti. Biraayaan Ruwiiz Dimitar Berbaatoov utubaa rukutee booda tokko deebiseera, Bulgaariyaanichis yeroo boodaa carraaqqiin isaa ala ta'ee murteeffameera yeroo gareen Landan bara dhumarratti naannoo gad aantummaa irraa qabxii afur qofa olitti sadarkaa 14ffaa irra xumuran. Wiigan gad aantummaa irraa baheera eegaa garee rakkataa Aston Viilaa mo'amuu sadii walitti aansuun kan hoggantuu Pool Laambeert irratti dhiibbaa dabaluuf ta'e booda Cheelsiin 8-0n diigamuu fi mo'amuu manaa 4-0n Siiparsiin. Riidiing sadarkaa lammaffaa irraa gaditti turan eegaa kilabichi ol guddatee yeroo lammaffaa qofa yeroo kana injifannoo argate, galchii daqiiqaa shanaffaa taphataa fuulduraa Raashiyaa Paavel Pogrebniyaak kan sadarkaa 12ffaa irra jiru Weest Haam yeroo taphoota afuriif kan hin injifanne dheereessuun.

article_content: A London branch of the upscale estate agent Savills has prohibited employees from engaging in sexual activity at work. This decision follows an incident where used condoms caused significant blockages in the office toilets. According to a leaked email, reportedly from a senior Savills manager in Sloane Street, Pimlico Plumbers spent seven hours resolving toilet problems. Richard Gutteridge, a director of residential housing, sent a memo to approximately 50 staff members at the branch. He cautioned that "obviously such activity should not be taking place in the office". The email explained that emergency plumbing work was required, costing the office a substantial sum. Plumbers discovered a large mass of used condoms blocking the pipes after seven hours of work. This blockage prevented the toilets from draining correctly. Mr. Gutteridge reiterated the warning and asked staff to be considerate of the "ancient Sloane Street plumbing". The leaked email prompted internal speculation about those involved. Savills public relations team contacted the Metro to clarify that the Sloane Street branch shares its plumbing with neighboring buildings. The PR representative stated that plumbers were called to investigate issues in the ladies’ restrooms. They found the main drainage system, shared with adjacent buildings, blocked with debris, including condoms. The blockage has since been removed, and the system is now functioning properly.

Murteesoon kun kan dhufe, yeroo kondoomiin fayyadamaniin mana fincaanii biiroo keessatti cufaa cimaa uumamee booda. Akka iimeelii dillaallee, kan akka gabaasametti hoogganaa olaanaa Savills kan Daandii Silon keessaa ta’e irraa barreeffameetti, Pimlico Plumbers mana fincaanii irratti rakkoo jiru hiikuuf sa’aatii torba dabarsaniiru. Richard Gutteridge, daayreektarri manneen jireenyaa, barreeffama yaadannoo hojjettoota damee sana keessaa naannoo 50 ta’aniif ergeera. Innis "haalli akkasii biiroo keessatti raawwatamuu hin qabu" jechuun akeekkachiiseera. Iimeelichi akka ibsetti, hojiin piombingii ariifachiisaa barbaachisaa ta’ee, kun ammoo biiroof qarshii baay’ee akka kaffalchiise. Piombariin sa’aatii torbaa booda kondoomiin fayyadamaniin baay’een isaan keessa cufaa uumee akka jiru argataniiru. Cuffaan kun mana fincaanii sirriitti akka hin goggogne dhoorkeera. Obbo Gutteridge akeekkachiisa kana irra deebi’anii kennanii, hojjettoonni "piombingii durii Daandii Silon" akka kabajan gaafataniiru. article_content: During a discussion, former President Barack Obama stated that he recognized the September 11, 2012 attack on the U.S. Consulate in Benghazi, Libya, as a terrorist act within a single day. However, former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney contended that it took two weeks for the president to acknowledge it as such. This article examines a timeline of the Obama administration's public statements regarding the Benghazi attack to verify these claims. The claim in question is based on Obama's statement: "The day following the attack, Governor, I stood in the Rose Garden and informed the American people and the global community that we would ascertain exactly what transpired. I stated that it was an act of terror and that we would pursue those responsible for this crime." Romney counterclaimed: "It took the president 14 days before he referred to the attack in Benghazi as an act of terror." The facts reveal that on September 12, 2012, the day after the attack that resulted in the deaths of four Americans, including U.S. Ambassador J. Christopher Stevens, Obama addressed the nation from the Rose Garden. He mentioned learning about the consulate attack the previous night. Fact Check: What was the status of security in Benghazi? Obama stated, "Our nation's strength is rooted in the character of our people and the dedication of those, both civilian and military, who represent us worldwide. No terrorist actions will ever undermine the resolve of this great nation, alter our character, or diminish the values we uphold. Today, we mourn four more Americans who embody the best of the United States. We remain steadfast in our commitment to ensure justice is served for this horrific act. Let there be no doubt, justice will be done." Opinion: Do facts still hold importance? On September 13, 2012, speaking at a campaign event in Las Vegas, Obama reiterated his vow to bring the perpetrators to justice. He added, "No act of terror will obscure the values we proudly project to the world, and no act of violence will weaken the resolve of the United States of America." Conversely, other administration officials indicated in the following days that they lacked credible intelligence suggesting the attack was pre-planned. On September 13, 2012, State Department spokeswoman Victoria Nuland stated that authorities were "being very cautious about drawing conclusions regarding the perpetrators, their motivations, and whether it was premeditated" until the investigation concluded. On September 16, 2012, Susan Rice, the U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, said, "Currently, we do not possess information that leads us to believe this was premeditated or preplanned." However, on September 19, 2012, Matthew Olsen, director of the National Counterterrorism Center, informed the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee that the ambassador and three other Americans "were killed during a terrorist attack on our embassy." White House spokesman Jay Carney addressed the apparent confusion on September 20, 2012, stating, "I believe it is self-evident that the events in Benghazi constituted a terrorist attack. Our embassy was violently attacked, resulting in the deaths of four American officials." On September 25, 2012, during an interview on ABC's "The View," Joy Behar questioned Obama about a statement from his secretary of state. "I heard Hillary Clinton say it was an act of terrorism. Is it? What is your perspective?" Obama responded, "We are still conducting an investigation. There is no question that considering the types of weapons used and the sustained nature of the assault, it was more than just a mob action. We are still gathering information and do not have all the details yet. However, it is evident that numerous threats persist globally." Obama further mentioned that "extremist militias" were suspected of involvement. Fact Check: Did Obama publicly express a desire for 'daylight' between the U.S. and Israel? Two days later, Carney directly addressed a question about why Obama had not labeled the incident a terrorist attack. "I believe there is a misunderstanding here," Carney stated. "I serve as the president's spokesman. When the head of the National Counterterrorism Center, Matt Olsen, in open congressional testimony, responded affirmatively to a question by stating, based on our definitions – and I am paraphrasing – that it was a terrorist attack, I reiterated that. This reflects the president's and the administration's reliance on the intelligence community for assessments on this matter. It has been the president's position since I made that statement that this was a terrorist attack." Conclusion: Romney's assertion was factually incorrect. Obama did describe the killings in Benghazi as an act of terror on two occasions within the two days following the attack. Although, in an interview two weeks later, he appeared to withhold definitive judgment, and some Obama administration officials, including Carney and Rice, suggested in the days immediately following the attack that the United States lacked indications of a planned assault. For comprehensive coverage, refer to CNN's Fact Checks.

Shakkiin tokko illee hin jiraatin, haqi ni argama." Yaada: Dhugaan amma illee barbaachisummaa qabaa? Fulbaana 13, 2012, yeroo tamsaasa duulaa Laas Veegasitti argamutti, Obaamaan yakka raawwattoota haqaatti dhiheessuuf waadaa isaanii irra deebi’anii mirkaneessan. Itti dabaluunis, "Gochi shororkaa kamiyyuu gatiiwwan nuti addunyaatti boonaan agarsiisnu hin dhoksu, akkasumas gochi jeequmsaa kamiyyuu kutannoo Ameerikaa hin dadhabsiisu." Gama biraatiin, hooggantoonni mootummaa biroo guyyoota itti aananitti odeeffannoo amanamaa haleellichi duraan karoorfamee raawwatame kan jedhu akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Fulbaana 13, 2012, dubbi himtuun Ministeera Dhimma Alaa Viiktoriyaa Nuulaandi, abbootiin taayitaa "eenyu akka raawwate, kaayyoon isaanii maali akka ta’e, akkasumas duraan karoorfamee raawwatamee kan jedhu ilaalchisee yeroo qorannoon xumuramu murtoo kennuuf baay’ee of eeggannoo akka taasisan" dubbatan. Dubbi himaan Mana Maree Bakka Bu’ootaa Jee Kaarneeyi Fulbaana 20, 2012, burjaaja’aa’uu mul’atu furuuf yaalii godhanii, "Waan Beenghaazii keessatti raawwatame haleellaa shororkaa akka ta’e ifatti kan mul’atuudha jedheen amana. Embaasiin keenya humnaan haleelamee, bu’aan isaas du’a hooggantoota Ameerikaa afuriiti." Fulbaana 25, 2012, yeroo gaafannoo ABC’s "The View" irratti, Jooy Bihaar waa’ee ibsa sekretarii isaa dhimma alaa kennan Obaamaa gaafatan. "Hiilaarii Kiliintan gocha shororkaa akka ta’e yeroo dubbatan dhaga’eera. Akkasumaa? Maaltu sitti fakkaata?" Obaamaan deebisanii, "Amma illee qorannoo gaggeessaa jirra. Gosa meeshaa waraanaa fayyadamanii fi haleellaan itti fufiinsaan raawwatame yoo ilaalamu, sochii garee humnaan guutame qofa akka hin taane shakkii hin qabu. Amma illee odeeffannoo walitti qabaa jirra, bal’inaan hin qabnu. Haa ta’u malee, sodaan hedduun addunyaa maratti akka jiru ifaadha." Obaamaan itti dabaluunis "gareewwan hidhattoota shororkaa" keessatti hirmaataniiru jedhamee akka shakkame dubbatan. Dhugaa Mirkaneessaa: Obaamaan ifatti ‘ifni’ Ameerikaa fi Israa’el gidduutti akka jiraatu barbaadaa jechuu isaanii turee? Guyyoota lama booda, Kaarneeyi sababa Obaamaan sababa kanaaf gocha shororkaa hin moggaasneef gaaffii dhihaateef kallattiin deebisanii. Erga ani akkas jedhee kaasee, pirezidaantichi gochi kun haleellaa shororkaa akka ta’e ejjennoo isaaniiti." Xumurri: Mormiin Roombii dhugaa hin turre. Obaamaan ajjeechaa Beenghaazii keessatti raawwatame guyyoota haleellaa sanaa booda guyyoota lama keessatti yeroo lama akka gocha shororkaa ibsaniiru. article_content: Floyd Mayweather Jr. has officially ended his professional relationship with Golden Boy Promotions. This separation comes after Richard Schaefer stepped down from his position as chief executive officer of the boxing promotion company. Mayweather has openly expressed his negative feelings towards Oscar De La Hoya, the president of Golden Boy.  Their strained relationship dates back to their 2007 fight. The boxing champion, holding titles in both the junior middleweight and welterweight divisions, had collaborated with Golden Boy primarily due to his strong bond with Schaefer. Mayweather also co-promoted his own fights through his company, Mayweather Promotions. The exit of Mayweather is anticipated to have significant financial repercussions for Golden Boy, potentially resulting in millions of dollars in lost income. Mayweather is expected to return to the boxing ring around September 13.  He recently extended his undefeated record to 46 wins after defeating Marcos Maidana on May 3. Following his resignation on Monday, Schaefer, a former banker from Switzerland, released a public statement explaining his decision. Schaefer stated that after more than 10 years with Golden Boy, he felt it was the right moment to pursue a new phase in his career.  He described it as a decision requiring considerable personal thought, concluding that leaving was necessary. He acknowledged his past successes in banking and boxing and expressed anticipation for future opportunities. Schaefer also mentioned he remains a shareholder in Golden Boy, indicating a continued vested interest in the organization's success and pride in past achievements, while being eager for new challenges. There is speculation that Schaefer might join forces with Mayweather Promotions or establish his own venture, potentially co-promoting Mayweather's fights, similar to the previous arrangement with Golden Boy. It was reported that the relationship between De La Hoya and Schaefer had been deteriorating for some time before these events occurred.

article_content: Olympic gold medalist skier Bode Miller has spoken about the pain of learning his younger brother, Chelone Miller, was found dead from an apparent seizure in a van near the mountains in California. 'He loved life so much; it made him easy to love and easy to be around,' Bode told The Ski Channel shortly after learning about Chelone Miller's passing. 'I'm going to miss him a lot.' Chelone, an Olympic hopeful in snowboarding who had competed globally, was found unresponsive by emergency workers in Mammoth Lakes. Tragedy: Chelone Miller, younger brother of Olympic skier Bode Miller, was found dead in his van in the California mountains on Sunday. Devastated: Bode Miller, pictured in October with his wife Morgan Beck, is heartbroken over his younger brother's death. The Miller family grew up in rural New Hampshire without electricity or indoor plumbing. Troubled past: Professional snowboarder Chelone Miller had a prior arrest for marijuana possession, and his best friend was involved in a case where a cop was killed. Beloved: Chelone Miller, known as 'Chilly' to friends, was admired in Mammoth Lakes for his snowboarding skills and 'optimism and kind personality'. Top of his sport: Skiing star Bode Miller has won five Olympic medals, including one gold, and aimed to compete in future games. Officials responded after a close friend discovered Miller, 29, nicknamed 'Chilly', around 12:45 p.m. Sunday in his van, parked outside the friend's home. ESPN reported Miller had been living in the van. The Mono County Sheriff's Office confirmed his death Monday, stating that while the cause was under investigation, foul play was not suspected. Paramedics, the fire department, and deputies arrived at the scene and confirmed 'Mr. Miller was deceased', according to the Sheriff's statement. The U.S. Olympic Snowboarding team released a statement indicating he died from 'an apparent seizure.' Chelone Miller is pictured at the Rahlves Banzai Tour event last month where he placed first. Following his big brother: Chelone Miller, six years younger than Olympian Bode, aspired to join him at the Sochi 2014 Games as a snowboarder. 'Chelone Miller was an aspiring elite athlete who made great progress as a snowboardcross rider this past season,' stated the President of U.S. Snowboarding. Miller had a history of seizures following a 2005 motorcycle crash that left him in a coma for 11 days and caused a month of memory loss. The accident occurred near his New Hampshire hometown. Miller once suffered a seizure on a chairlift, falling 25 feet onto his back. He was well-known in Mammoth Lakes, admired for his bravery and dedication to snowboardcross. Originally from Easton, N.H., Miller hoped to join the U.S. snowboardcross squad for the 2014 Sochi Games. Last month, Chelone Miller won the Rahlves Banzai Tour overall title after winning at Sugar Bowl, California. The event is organized by Daron Rahlves, former World Cup and Olympic skier. @RahlvesBanzai tweeted: 'RIP Chilly..We will miss you, but never forget! Thoughts go out to @MillerBode and his family.' Miller recently finished fourth at the 2013 U.S. Snowboarding Grand Prix in Canyons, Utah. Chelone, the younger brother of Bode Miller, pictured, dreamed of competing in the 2014 Olympics. Besides competing, Miller also filmed with Warren Miller and other production companies. Bode Miller's wife, Morgan Beck, tweeted on Monday: 'Keep loved ones close and remind them daily how special they are. Life is precious and fragile.' U.S. Ski and Snowboard Association President Bill Marolt said on the team's website: 'Chelone Miller was an aspiring elite athlete who made great progress as a snowboardcross rider this past season.' 'We are deeply saddened by his death and offer condolences to the Miller family.' The statement added Miller 'was known equally for his optimism and kind personality as for his fearless presence on Mammoth Mountain's biggest park features.' Miller spent the weekend golfing and snowboarding. Nate Holland, a seven-time X Games gold medalist and snowboardcross competitor, said, 'Chilly always did things his way.' 'He'd appear in his van, like a lone wolf, and perform incredibly. He was a hard-charging snowboarder,' Holland told ESPN. Holland, in Alaska, expected to see Miller at the Arctic Man event. Holland recalled that at last year's event, Miller had a seizure on race day and was airlifted to a hospital. After stabilizing, Miller returned and raced. 'I remember the organizer saying, "If Chilly wants to race, he races, and we'll wait until he's back from the hospital to finish,"' Holland remembered. The race is on Friday, combining snowmobilers with skiers and snowboarders reaching speeds over 80 mph. John Teller, a Mammoth-based skicross racer and 2011 X Games gold medalist, said, 'He was a very talented snowboarder and a great friend.' Many Olympic athletes expressed condolences on Twitter. Freestyle skier and two-time Olympian Emily Cook wrote: 'Broken-hearted to hear about Chelone Miller's passing. Sending love and prayers to Bode, friends, and family.' Snowboarder Elena Hight tweeted: 'My heart goes out to @MillerBode and family. So sad for the loss of a great person. #RIPchilly.' Miller was one of four children. Raised on a farm without electricity or running water, they learned to ski early. He started snowboarding at nine. Bode Miller is a five-time Olympic medalist in alpine skiing. He missed the 2012-13 World Cup season due to a knee injury, but won gold at the 2010 Vancouver Games. Last month, he filed court documents to compel Sara McKenna, his ex-lover and mother of his infant son, to relocate to California for visitation. He also seeks to change his son's surname to Miller. Ms. McKenna reportedly claimed Mr. Miller did not want her to have the child. Meanwhile, Mr. Miller's wife, Morgan Beck, married late last year after a romance that began soon after Ms. McKenna's pregnancy, suffered a miscarriage last year after announcing her pregnancy. 'Trying to be a good parent:' Miller with four-year-old Neesyn Darcey, his daughter with Chanel Johnson, subject of a custody suit. High flying: The conflict between McKenna and Miller's wife, Morgan Beck, has become bitter. Chelone Miller was found dead on Sunday at the popular Mammoth Lakes ski resort in California.

Paaraamedikoonni, dameen ibiddaa fi itti gaafatamtoonni gara bakka sanatti ergaman, yeroo achi ga'an 'Obbo Miller du'ee akka jiru mirteeffame', ibsichi jedheera. Gareen Isnoobordii Olompikii U.S. ibsa keessatti 'qabsiisaa ifa ta'een akka du'e' ibseera. Kunoo Chelone Miller taphaa Rahlves Banzai Tour ji'a darbe kan inni sadarkaa tokkoffaa argateetti. Obboleessa isaa isa guddaa hordofaa: Chelone Miller obboleessa isaa Olompikii Bode caalaa waggaa jahaan xinnaa ture, akkasumas taphawwan Sochi 2014tti isnoobordaa ta'uun isa waliin makamuuf abdata ture. 'Chelone Miller atleetii olaanaa ta'uuf abdatu kan ta'e yoo ta'u, kunis akka atleetii isnoobordii kroositti guddina guddaa kan argamsiise yeroo taphaa darbe kana': Pirezidaantiin Isnoobordii U.S. Miller ilaalchisee dubbateera. Miller seenaa qabsiisaa kan qabu kan balaa konkolaataa 2005 booda kan isa guyyaa 11f komaatti galcheen ture. Akkasumas balaa magaalaa dhalootaa isaa New Hampshireitti dhihoo ga'ee booda ji'a tokkoof yaadannoo isaa dhabeera. Miller yeroo tokko qabsiisaan isa mudee yeroo teessoo ol kaasanirratti argamuufi meetira 25 ol duubatti kufee ture. Inni magaalaa isaa fudhate Mammoth Lakes keessatti baay'ee beekamaa kan ture, kan inni jabinaa fi of kenniinsa isaa ispoortii balaa qabu kan ta'e isnoobordii kroosiif dinqisiifatamaa ture. Miller, kan dhalootaan Easton, N.H., garee U.S. isnoobordii kroosif taphawwan Sochi 2014tti makamuuf abdataa ture. Ji'a darbe qofa, Chelone Miller injifannoo Sugar Bowl Kaalifoorniyaatti argameen maqaa guutuu Rahlves Banzai Tour injifateera. Taphichi kan qophaa'e Daron Rahlves, kan duraan Kubbaa Addunyaa fi Atleetii Olompikii ta'een. Akaawuntiin Tiwiitaraa @RahlvesBanzai tiwiiteera: 'RIP Chilly..Sin dhabna, garuu matumaa hin irraanfannu! Yaanni keenya @MillerBode fi maatii isaaf haa ta'u.' Miller dhiheenya kana sadarkaa afuraffaa kan taphaa 2013 U.S. Isnoobordii Grand Prix Canyons, Yuutaatti xumureera. Obboleessi xinnaa Bode Miller, kan suuraan argisiifame, Chelone Olompikii 2014tti dorgomuuf abjuu qaba ture. Dorgomuu dabalataan, Miller filmii Warren Miller fi dhaabbilee oomishaa biroo waliin hojjeteera. Haati manaa Bode Miller, atleetii kubbaa voli Morgan Beck, Wiixata Tiwiiteeraan: 'Warra jaallattanitti dhihaadhaa akkasumas guyyaa guyyaatti hammam isaan addaa akka ta'an isaan yaadachiisaa. Jireenyi baay'ee gatii guddaa fi laafaa dha.' Pirezidaantiin Waldaa Iskiingii fi Isnoobordii U.S. Bill Marolt ibsa garee sanaa weebsaayitii irratti: 'Chelone Miller atleetii olaanaa ta'uuf abdatu kan ta'e yoo ta'u, kunis akka atleetii isnoobordii kroositti guddina guddaa kan argamsiise yeroo taphaa darbe kana. ' 'Du'a isaa dhaga'uu keenyatti baay'ee gaddineerra akkasumas jajjabina keenya maatii Miller guutuuf dabarsina.' Ibsichi dabalataan 'Miller abdii fi amala gaarii isaatiin baay'ee beekamaa kan ture akka argamuufi fuula sodaa hin qabne paarkii Mammoth Mountain isa guddaarratti,' jedheera. Miller torban dabre tapha golfaa fi isnoobordii taphatee dabarseera. 'Chilly yeroo hundumaa akka nama wantoota karaa isaa hojjetuutti natti dhaga'ama,' Nate Holland, meedaaliyaa warqee X Games torba kan qabu kan Miller waliin isnoobordii kroositti dorgomee ture, jedheera. 'Inni achiifi as konkolaataa isaa keessatti akka saree bosonaa tokkootti mul'ata, akkasumas gadi bu'a. Inni isnoobordaa cimaa ture,' Holland ESPNtti himeera. Holland Alaskaa keessa jira, achitti Miller taphaa Arctic Manif arguu abdataa ture. Taphicha waggaa darbe, Holland akka jedhetti, Miller guyyaa taphichaa qabsiisaan isa mudee gara hospitaalaatti balaliifameera. Erga tasgabbaa'ee booda, Miller gara dirree taphaatti deebi'ee dorgomeera. 'Qopheessaan yeroo akkana jedhu nan yaadadha, "Yoo Chilly dorgomaan jira jedhe, inni dorgomaa dha, akkasumas taphicha kana hanga inni hospitaalaa deebi'utti hin xumurrru,"' Holland yaadateera. Taphichi Jimaata. Taphicha kan isnoomobilaawwaniin atleetota iskiingii fi isnoobordii saffisa sa'aatii tokkotti 80 mph caaluun walitti makudha. 'Inni isnoobordaa baay'ee dandeettii qabuufi michuu guddaa ture,' John Teller, atleetii iskiikroos kan Mammoth keessa jiraatu kan meedaaliyaa warqee X Games 2011tti injifate jedheera. Atleettoonni Olompikii hedduun jajjabina isaanii Tiwiitara irratti ibsaniiru. Atleetii iskiingii bilisaa fi Olompikii yeroo lamaa Emily Cook akkana jettee barreesse: 'Du'a Chelone Miller dhaga'uu keenyatti gaddineerra. Jaalalaa fi kadhannaa Bode, michoota fi maatii isaaf dabarsina.' Isnoobordarri Elena Hight tiwiiteeraan: 'Garaan koo @MillerBode fi maatii isaaf haa ta'u. Dhabuu nama guddaa akkanaatiif baay'ee gaddisiisaa dha. #RIPchilly.' Miller ijoollee afur keessaa tokko ture. Maatiin kun mana qonnaa elektiriikii fi bishaan dhangala'aa malee guddatan, garuu iskiingii daa'imman ta'anii baratan. Inni isnoobordii taphachuu umurii sagaliitti jalqabeera. Bode Miller meedaaliyaa Olompikii al shan kan iskiingii alpaayinii dha. Inni taphaa Kubbaa Addunyaa 2012-13 kan madaa jilbaa irraa fayyaa deebi'uuf dhiiseera. Inni meedaaliyaa warqee taphawwan 2010 Vaankuvaritti injifateera. Ji'a darbe galmee mana murtiitti dhiheessuun Sara McKenna, jaalallee isaa duraanii fi haadha ilma isaa xiqqaa, akka gara Kaalifoorniyaatti deebi'uuf dirqisiisuuf kan inni yeroo ijoollee sana waliin dabarsuu danda'uuf. Akkasumas maqaan dhalootaa ijoollee sanaa gara Milleritti akka jijjiiramu gochuuf yaalaa jira. Obbo McKenna akka gabaasametti Obbo Miller ijoollee sana akka isheen hin qabaanne barbaaduu dhiiseera. Yeroo kanatti, haati manaa Obbo Miller, atleetii kubbaa voli Morgan Beck, kan inni dhuma waggaa darbe kan fuudhe erga jaalalli ishee Obbo McKenna ulfaa'ee booda kan jalqabame, garuu ulfi ishee erga beeksistee booda waggaa darbe ulfi ishee harca'eera. 'Abbaa fi haadha gaarii ta'uuf yaalaa jira: 'Miller ijoollee umuriin isaanii waggaa afur Neesyn Darcey, intala isaa Chanel Johnsoniin kan walii galan, kan dhimma kun himannaa kunuunsa ijoollee jala jiru. Balali'aa ol'aanaa: Lolli McKennaa fi haadha manaa Miller, atleetii kubbaa voli Morgan Beck, gidduutti baay'ee hadhaa'aa ta'eera. Bakki iskiingii jaallatamaan Mammoth Lakes Kaalifoorniyaa, bakka Chelone Miller Dilbata du'ee argame.

article_content: A soap opera actress, known for her roles in 'One Life to Live' and 'Guiding Light', has avoided a prison sentence after allegedly smashing a pint glass into another woman's face during a bar brawl. Crystal Hunt, 29, a former Daytime Emmy Award nominee, reportedly threw the glass at the victim following an argument at Pearl's Liquor Bar in West Hollywood on December 13, according to prosecutors speaking to TMZ. The unnamed woman sustained facial cuts and required medical treatment. Hunt was arrested and charged with felony assault with a deadly weapon.  Hunt, pictured, pleaded no contest yesterday to one count of felony assault by means likely to produce great bodily injury, as stated by the Los Angeles County District Attorney’s Office. Had she pleaded not guilty and been convicted, she could have faced up to five years in prison, OnTheRedCarpet.com reported. Instead, LA Superior Court Judge Kathryn Solorzano sentenced Hunt to three years of probation and 45 days of work for the California Department of Transportation. Following her arrest in December 2013, Hunt reportedly claimed self-defense, stating she threw a pint glass of water because the woman was harassing her. She added that she had asked security to remove the woman and intended only to throw water, but the glass slipped, Musictimes.com reported. Hunt began her career in pageants and commercials and is best known for playing Lizzie Spaulding in CBS's 'Guiding Light'. This role earned her a Daytime Emmy Award nomination in 2005. From 2008 to 2011, Hunt played Stacy Morasco in 'One Life to Live'. She also has movie credits, including 'Sydney White' with Amanda Bynes, 'Brooklyn to Manhattan', and 'The Derby Stallion'.  Outside acting, Hunt owns My Pet’s Dream Boutique, a high-end pet supply store in Clearwater. In 2009, she was engaged to Tampa cancer surgeon Philippe Spiess, but they ended their relationship just over a year later.

Kiristaal Hant, 29, kan yeroo tokkoo Badhaasa Emmy kan guyyaa argatte, akka gabaasaatti, walitti bu'iinsa booda miidhagina shamarranii Pearl's Liquor Bar West Hollywood keessatti Muddee 13tti darbatte, akka abbaan alangaa TMZ'tti himanitti. Shamarran maqaan hin dhahamne madaa fuula irraa qabattee yaala fayyaa barbaadde. Hant qabamtee yakka cimaa meeshaa ajjeesaa qabuun himatamte. Hant, kan suuraan ishee agarsiifamu, kaleessa yakka cimaa qaama miidhaa guddaa fiduu danda'uun himannaa hin mormine, akka ibsa Waajjira Abbaa Alangaa Aanaa Los Angelesitti. Utuu yakka hin qabne jedhanii yakkamtummaatti murteeffamanii, waggaa shanitti hidhamuu danda'u turan, OnTheRedCarpet.com gabaasee jira. Kanaa mannaa, Abbaan Murtii Olaanaa LA Kathryn Solorzano Hantitti hidhaa mana hidhaa irraa bilisa baasuun waggaa sadii kan eegumsaa fi guyyaa 45 hojii Dhaabbata Geejjibaa Californiaaf murteesse. Qabamuu ishee booda Muddee 2013tti, Hant akka ofirraa ittisuuf gochaa turte dubbatte, akka himamutti miidhagina biiraa bishaaniin guutamee darbatte sababni isaas shamarran sun ishee rakkisaa turteef. Itti dabaluunis, isheen nageenyaaf shamarran sana bar irraa akka baasan gaafattee akka bishaan ishee qofa shamarraniitti darbachuu yaalte, garuu miidhaginni ishee harkaa bu'e, Musictimes.com gabaasee jira. Hant hojii ishee dorgommii miidhaginaa fi beeksisa keessatti jalqabde, fi kan beekamtetti taphaa Lizzie Spaulding CBS's 'Guiding Light' keessatti. Taphaan kun Badhaasa Emmy kan Guyyaa bara 2005tti argamsiise. Bara 2008 hanga 2011tti, Hant taphaa Stacy Morasco 'One Life to Live' keessatti taphatte. Akkasumas, filmiiwwan keessatti argamteetti, kanneen akka 'Sydney White' kan Amanda Bynes waliin, 'Brooklyn to Manhattan', fi 'The Derby Stallion'. Hojii ishee taphaatiin alatti, Hant My Pet’s Dream Boutique, daldala dhiyeessii bineensotaa sadarkaa ol aanoo qabu kan Clearwater keessatti argamu qabdi. Bara 2009tti, isheen dhiira fayyaa dhibee kaansarii Tampa Philippe Spiess waliin walii galtee heerumaa qabatte, garuu walitti dhufeenya isaanii waggaa tokkoo oliin booda addaan kutan.

article_content: Hong Kong achieved a comfortable 4-0 victory over Bhutan on Thursday, significantly improving their chances of advancing to the second round of the Asian preliminaries for the 2026 World Cup.  Indonesia and Myanmar also secured convincing first-leg wins against Brunei and Macau, respectively. Michael Udebuluzor scored two headers in the 10th and 16th minutes, setting Hong Kong on their path to victory. Shinichi Chan added a third goal, and an own goal by Tenzin Norbu in the 35th minute completed the scoring before the second leg in Thimphu on Tuesday. "We had a strong first half," commented Hong Kong coach Jorn Andersen. "We performed well, created numerous opportunities, and scored goals. We could have scored more in the first half, given the chances we had. However, I was less pleased with our second-half performance." In Yangon, Myanmar overwhelmed Macau with a 5-1 victory.  After Niki Torrao equalized Lwin Moe Aung's 39th-minute opening goal for Myanmar, Myanmar scored four more times in the last half-hour through Soe Moe Kyaw, Aung Kaung Mann, Nay Moe Naing, and Lwin Moe Aung. The return match is scheduled in Macau. Indonesia dominated Brunei in Jakarta, winning 6-0. Dimas Drajad completed his hat-trick in stoppage time, adding to Indonesia's dominant performance under coach Shin Tae-yong. Taiwan also secured a decisive 4-0 victory over Timor-Leste, with Yu Yao-hsing scoring twice. In Male, Saad Uddin scored in stoppage time for Bangladesh to secure a 1-1 draw against the Maldives, who had taken the lead five minutes earlier through Hassan Nazeem. Singapore edged out Guam 2-1, thanks to first-half goals from Christopher van Huizen and Jacob Mahler. Jason Cunliffe scored for Guam in the final minute, giving them some hope for the second leg. Nepal and Laos played to a 1-1 draw in Kathmandu, while Cambodia and Pakistan played a goalless draw in Phnom Penh. Jabar Sharza scored the only goal for Afghanistan in their 1-0 win over 10-man Mongolia in Dushanbe.  Yemen secured a strong 3-0 lead against Sri Lanka with goals from Ahmed Maher, Nasser Mohammedoh, and Abdulwasea Al Matari. The second leg matches are scheduled for Tuesday. The winners will advance to the second round, where 36 teams will be divided into nine groups. The top two teams from each group will then proceed to the third phase of the preliminaries. Asia will have eight guaranteed spots in the expanded 48-team World Cup in Canada, Mexico, and the United States, with a potential ninth spot available through an intercontinental playoff.

article_content: By Graham Smith. Last updated at 6:18 PM on 15th December 2011. A tainted batch of bootleg alcohol has killed at least 143 people, with hundreds more being treated at hospitals in villages outside the eastern Indian city of Kolkata. Day labourers and other poor workers began falling ill on Tuesday evening after drinking the brew, which was laced with methanol. Police have arrested ten suspected people in connection with making and distributing the toxic alcohol around the village of Sangrampur, about 20 miles south of Kolkata. Distraught relatives of victims wait for news outside Diamond Harbour hospital near Kolkata in India after a batch of bootleg alcohol killed at least 102 people. Emergency personnel carried half-conscious patients into hospitals on stretchers, and treated them on the floor due to a lack of beds. Tragically, two victims lie outside a mortuary at Diamond Harbour hospital. Mamata Banerjee, chief minister of the state of West Bengal, has promised a crackdown. She said: 'I want to take strong action against those manufacturing and selling illegal liquor.' 'But this is also a social problem, and this has to be dealt with socially as well as through legal action.' The deaths occurred days after more than 90 people were killed in a hospital fire in nearby Kolkata, which led to the arrest of the facility's directors for culpable homicide. The latest tragedy began when groups of poor labourers finished work and bought cheap homemade booze for about 10 rupees (12p) per half litre, less than a third of the price of legal alcohol. The men were drinking along the roadside near the railway station when they began vomiting, suffering piercing headaches and frothing at the mouth, district magistrate Narayan Swarup Nigam said. Bodies are laid on the ground before being transported to morgues. Police have arrested four people in connection with making and distributing the toxic alcohol. Family members mourn for their relatives. The latest tragedy began when groups of poor labourers finished work and bought cheap homemade booze for less than a third of the price of legal alcohol. Survivor Rahim Ullah was admitted for treatment after drinking the poisonous alcohol. Furious villagers ransacked the illegal alcohol shops. Zamir Sardar's 32-year-old uncle Jahangir Sardar, a leather cutter, passed away this morning. Mr Sardar said: 'He drank the alcohol late yesterday afternoon. We didn't realise his health was deteriorating.' 'In the morning, his condition seemed very unusual, he cried out in pain. Then we brought him to the hospital as soon as we could, but he passed away within a couple of hours.' Half-conscious patients were carried into hospitals on stretchers and treated on the floor due to lack of beds. Cheap bootleg alcohol kills dozens of people every year in India. In 2009, at least 112 people died from a toxic brew in western India.

Alkooliin seeraan alaa kan summii qabu yoo xiqqaate namoota 143 ajjeeseera, dabalataan dhibbootaan lakkaa'aman magaalaa Hindii bahaa kan Kolkaataa alatti gandeen keessatti yaalamaa jiru. Hojjetoota guyyaa fi hojjettoonni hiyyeessaa biroo Jimaata galgala dhukkubsachuu kan eegalan dhugaatii, kan meetaanolii wajjin makame erga dhuganii booda. Poolisiin namoota shakkamtoota kudhan kan alkoolii summii qabu naannoo ganda Sangraampuuritti, kan Kolkaataadhaa gara kibbaatti mailii 20 fagaatu, oomishuu fi raabsuu wajjin wal qabatee qabateera. Firoottan namoota miidhaman kan gaddan Diamond Haarbara hospitaala Kolkaataa dhihoo Hindii keessatti argamuutti oduu eeggachaa jiru erga alkooliin seeraan alaa yoo xiqqaate namoota 102 ajjeesee booda. Hojjettoonni ariifachiisaa dhukkubsattoota wal-wallaalaa ta'an siree harkisaa irratti hospitaalota keessaatti baatanii, lafa irratti kan yaalaman sireen waan hin jirreef. Gaddisiisaa, namoonni miidhaman lama mana reeffaa Diamond Haarbara hospitaalaatti lafa ciisu. Mamaataa Banarjee, ministiraan muummee mootummaa West Bengal, tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatu waadaa galeera. Isheen akkana jette: 'Ani tarkaanfii cimaa warreen alkoolii seeraan alaa oomishanii fi gurguran irratti fudhachuu nan barbaada.' 'Garuu kun dhimma hawaasummaa akkasumas, kun hawaasummaadhan akkasumas tarkaanfii seeraa wajjin qabamuu qaba.' Duuti kun kan raawwatame guyyoota muraasa booda ibidda hospitaala Kolkaataa dhihoo keessatti ka'een namoonni 90 ol yeroo du'an, kunis daayrektaroota dhaabbataa sababa ajjeechaatiin akka qabaman taasiseera. Gaddi dhihoo kun kan jalqabame yeroo gareewwan hojjettoota hiyyeessaa hojii xumuranii dhugaatii manaa kan gatii gad aanaa qabu naannoo ruupii 10 (12p) walakkaa liitiraan tokkoof, gatii alkoolii seera qabeessaa keessaa sadaffaa gadi kan ta'e bitatan. Dhiironni daandii cinaatti buufata baaburaa dhihoo yeroo dhugaa turanitti yeroo of wallaalan, mataa bowwoo cimaa fi afaan keessaa waan baasuun dhukkubsachuu kan eegalan, magistireetiin distirikti Naaraayan Swaruup Nigam akkana jedhe. article_content: Ive watched my brother-in-law lavish ribs, potato salad and even nachos on his beloved pooch with reckless abandon. Give my dog Lulu a banana, and she returns it in a far less pleasant form. Thats why I spend the holidays policing relatives as they walk their nearly empty Thanksgiving plates to the kitchen. They mean well, they really do. But depositing scraps of ham, uneaten bits of mac and cheese and other yummies into my dogs bowl can do more holiday harm than good. While I appreciate the generosity, I dont relish the tummy troubles or the gassy nights that typically follow. "Pets are used to absorbing a certain amount of fat, carbohydrates and protein; [their diet] can be thrown out of balance during the holidays," says pet nutritionist Dr. Martin Glinsky, who began manufacturing holistic pet food in the 1980s. "The most common symptom is some form of loose stool or diarrhea and -- with my dog -- bouts of nausea. Shes just not used to the rich food we feed ourselves." Unfortunately, overly generous relatives arent the only threat to a pets digestive system. Dogs and cats have a knack for finding and consuming things they should avoid, particularly when their people are preoccupied. The ASPCAs poison control hotline (1-888-426-4435) handled 167,000 cases last year, says medical director Dr. Tina Wismer. Chocolate, a holiday staple, remains the No. 1 culprit. Pet insurance company VPI also notes a spike in claims related to chocolate poisoning during the holidays. The companys infamous "Hambone Award" even pays tribute to pets and the quirky things they consume, such as the Labrador that ate a Thanksgiving turkey carcass or a golden retriever that consumed an artificial Christmas wreath. Perhaps my brother-in-laws table scraps arent so bad in comparison. MNN: How to protect your pet from poisonous plants . But there are ways to help pets participate in holiday festivities without the risk of accidental injury or illness. Start by brushing up on basic obedience skills so that your pet will have tools to avoid temptation, says ASPCA trainer Kristen Collins. "Training your dog to 'leave it' on cue can be really useful when you have lots of people and tempting foods around," she says. "With lots of visitors, its also a great opportunity to teach your dog to greet people politely." Here are some tips to help dogs behave on a leash around houseguests. Collins suggests pet-friendly zones, complete with soft bedding, toys and chews. MNN: Downing Street defends "mouser-in-chief" "Pets become overwhelmed by people and sounds and smells during holidays," Collins says. "Its best to fix up a comfy confinement space for your pet." Of course, you also can be firm with guests who try to be a little too generous with the table scraps. "Most guests are conscious of your relationship with your dog and will say, 'Want me to save this?'" Glinsky says. "I have no problem saying, 'Please dont feed the dog. Shes on her own diet, and we dont feed her table scraps.' Your dog needs you for her well-being and she looks to you for that. Youve got to do whats necessary to provide her with that safety." article_content: Nathan Buhl, recently appointed principal of Milton High School and previously honored as Principal of the Year, has resigned following two drunk-driving incidents in a single night. Just two weeks before his scheduled start at the Georgia school, the 37-year-old was arrested twice. Mugshots depict Buhl with injuries from the crashes, which led to charges including hit and run, DUI, reckless driving, and failing to report striking an object. After spending three nights in jail across two counties, he resigned on Wednesday. On Saturday night, around 9:42 pm, Buhl allegedly struck a parked car in north Forsyth County. The car's owner witnessed the collision and reported Buhl's license plate to deputies. Forsyth County authorities contacted Cherokee County after discovering the vehicle registration originated there. An investigator confirmed a prior accident involving the same car.  Authorities found Buhl's car off-road, resting on its side between trees. A tire was missing, and car parts were scattered across nearby lawns, according to reports. Firefighters extracted Buhl, who sustained cuts and bruises, from his damaged Chrysler 200 after cutting through the windshield. Glen Edseth, owner of the parked car hit in the initial incident, described seeing Buhl driving erratically after the collision. "I suppose he probably didn't have any idea what he was doing," Edseth commented. Deputies from both counties apprehended Buhl at the hospital where he was taken for treatment. He was arrested on Sunday upon his release. Authorities stated Buhl admitted to consuming alcohol before driving but couldn't recall the accidents or specify how much he drank. A breathalyzer test revealed a BAC of 0.193, significantly exceeding Georgia's legal limit of 0.08. Buhl was initially booked into Forsyth County jail and released after posting an $8,525 bond. Charges there included DUI, hit and run, failure to report striking an object, and failure to maintain lane. Subsequently, he surrendered to Cherokee County jail and was released on Tuesday after posting a $3,551 bond. Cherokee County charges included DUI, reckless driving, weaving, and operating an unsafe vehicle. On Wednesday, Buhl resigned and sent an email of apology to colleagues and parents. "I am humbled and ashamed by the terrible decisions I made Saturday night," he wrote, describing a "night of celebration" that "quickly turned to nightmare." He expressed remorse and acknowledged the potential for fatal consequences.  Buhl reflected on his poor judgment, stating, "Teenagers wrestle with the same kind of choices I faced Saturday night on a regular basis. How can I stand before them and tell them to do what I say, not what I did?" Fulton County Schools Superintendent Robert Avossa expressed disappointment but stated Buhl "has done the right thing by stepping down," adding, "He is taking full responsibility for his actions and their consequences, and this sends the right message to the students and community we serve." Buhl, who is married, was appointed principal of Milton High School in April and was scheduled to begin his role in two weeks. An interim principal will be appointed while a permanent replacement is sought. Before Milton High, Buhl was principal at Crabapple Middle School, where he was named 2013-2014 Principal of the Year by the North Fulton PTA Council.

article_content: By Daily Mail Reporters PUBLISHED: 11:23 EST, January 13, 2014 UPDATED: 13:27 EST, January 13, 2014 The White House formally responded to a petition demanding an investigation into TV host Jimmy Kimmel on Sunday, after he aired a controversial segment where children joked about killing 'everyone in China'. The statement noted that the government 'cannot force ABC to remove this show' after a furious reaction to Kimmel's 'racist' skit and an online petition which secured over 105,000 signatures. This volume of complaints guaranteed that the petition, which compared the sketch to Nazi Germany, would receive a statement from the Obama administration. Scroll down for video During Jimmy Kimmel's 'Kids Table' segment on October 16, a six-year-old boy suggested as a 'debt solution': 'Kill everyone in China.' The sketch created widespread anger. 'Racist': Kimmel's oft-repeated gag involves posing serious questions to a group of giggling elementary school children, but this 'joke' was greeted with outrage and compared to Nazi Germany. 'America owes China a lot of money – $1.3 trillion. How should we pay them back?' Kimmel asked a group of four giggling kids in the October 16 broadcast segment. 'Shoot cannons all the way over and kill everyone in China,' offers a six-year-old boy. Kimmel also asks the group of children: 'Should we allow the Chinese to live?' One girl protests that the Chinese might respond in kind against Americans, but two others counter that 'they're going to all be killed' first. The broadcast created outrage, including demonstrations outside Kimmel's studios and the October 19 petition that stimulated the official White House response. Fury: The White House petition collected over 105,000 signatures, putting the ball in the administration's court and triggering a guaranteed response. Offensive: Chinese-American protests descended on an ABC broadcast affiliate in Houston, Texas to protest the show and ABC's 'fake apology' Thank you for your petition. Your petition requested an apology from those involved, and to 'cut the show.' The parties involved have already apologized independently. Jimmy Kimmel has apologized on-air, and issued a written apology. ABC has removed the skit from future broadcasts, taken the clip down from online platforms, and detailed several changes in its programming review process in response to this incident. You can find more about Jimmy Kimmel's apology here, and ABC's apology here. On a broader level, as the President has stated publicly, the United States welcomes the continuing peaceful rise of China. The comments you are writing about do not reflect mainstream views of China in the United States. The Federal government cannot force ABC to remove this show. The First Amendment of the Constitution protects free speech, even if individuals might personally find it offensive or distasteful. It may be upsetting when people say things we might personally disagree with, but the principle of protected free speech is an important part of who we are as a nation. If you think this issue merits additional scrutiny, you may file a complaint with the Federal Communications Commission by visiting FCC.gov/Complaints. The FCC is an independent agency that regulates the airwaves without input or consideration from the White House. The online petition launched by an 'H.Z.' in Cedar Park, Texas declared that 'the kids might not know anything better.' 'However, Jimmy Kimmel and ABC’s management are adults. They had a choice not to air this racist program, which promotes racial hatred. The program is totally unacceptable and it must be cut.' The petition's text also compared the children's wisecracking to 'rhetoric used in Nazi Germany against Jewish people. Please immediately cut the show and issue a formal apology.' Yesterday's answer from the White House, stated that the 'parties involved have already apologized independently.' 'We offer our sincere apology. Too far: Kimmel has pushed the comedy envelope for years, once co-hosting 'The Man Show,' a Comedy Central program that ended each week with a montage of girls jumping on trampolines. 'The First Amendment of the Constitution protects free speech, even if individuals might personally find it offensive or distasteful.' 'It may be upsetting when people say things we might personally disagree with, but the principle of protected free speech is an important part of who we are as a nation,' the response added.

article_content: By Chris Pleasance. When one very excited 10-year-old claimed to have found a mummy in his grandmother's attic, it took his parents a while to realize he wasn't making it up. But, unfortunately for little Alexander Kettler, from Diepholz, his historic find has proved to be a little less exciting than originally thought. It turns out that the supposed 2000-year-old Egyptian mummy is actually made of plastic, a discovery made after scientists finally unwrapped the corpse for inspection. Mysterious find: A 10-year-old German boy found what appeared to be a mummy in a sarcophagus in his grandmother's attic. Experts now claim they were fooled by a chemical spray which made the bones appear real. Lutz Gaebler, a Lower Saxony prosecutor who had declared the 'mummy' was 2,000 years old, has admitted that bone X-rays have proven him wrong. 'The mummy was unwrapped, and we have seen relatively quickly that the ingredients are not ancient,' he said. In an unexpected and slightly macabre twist, the mummy did contain a genuine skull, though an arrowhead found lodged in it appeared to come from a child's toy. Relic: Mr. Kettler believed that his father may have brought an unusual souvenir back from a trip to north Africa in the 1950s. Interest peaked in the so-called 'mummy of Diepholz' after it was found in the corner of an attic last month. Lutz Wolfgang Kettler, father of the boy who discovered it, theorized that his own father may have bought it while travelling in the 1950s when there was still a mummy trade operating. According to Kettler, 'unwrapping parties' - where a genuine mummy is unwrapped and the trinkets inside handed out - were not uncommon in Germany at the time. The sarcophagus was found alongside a death mask and a canopic jar - used to store organs extracted from the deceased - but these were quickly outed as fake. Kettler insisted on having the corpse itself tested though, intrigued at the possibility of it being real, despite some pointing out that the body was bound in 20th-century cloth. The mummification process dates back to 3,500BC with the oldest intact Egyptian mummy dating from 100 years after that. The mummy, known simply as ID #32751, is currently held by the British Museum. It was apparently preserved by direct contact with the dry desert sand, though it is uncertain whether the mummification was intended. The only mystery that now remains is why somebody would store a fake mummy in their attic for four decades. Tradition: Ancient Egyptians used to mummify both humans and animals when they died. Ancient Egyptians were firm believers in the afterlife when someone died. But they thought to get there, the body needed to be recognizable, so that the dead person could repossess it. The chief embalmer was a priest wearing the mask of Anubis - the jackal-headed God of the dead. First the brains would be pulled out of the person through the nose using a hook. Then all the internal organs would be removed, including the lungs, stomach, intestines, and liver and placed in jars. The heart would be replaced. The inside of the body would be rinsed with wine and spices before being covered with salt for 70 days. After 40 days it would be stuffed with linen to give it a more humane shape. At 70 days it would be wrapped in bandages and placed inside a brightly-painted coffin. Mainly wealthy people were mummified because poorer people could not afford it. Animals were also sometimes mummified as gestures to the Gods or so that they could accompany their owners in the afterlife.

article_content: Yankees star Alex Rodriguez has refuted claims of any ongoing plea discussions with Major League Baseball concerning accusations of using performance-enhancing substances, as he stated in a CNN interview with Jason Carroll this week. 'Currently, I don't believe there are any active discussions, and that's all I'm going to say on the matter,' Rodriguez commented. 'I believe in the importance of following due process. Major League Baseball has a robust system in place, and we should allow that system to operate.' Rodriguez spoke to CNN on Tuesday, just before his anticipated return to the Yankees lineup following his off-season operation. He expressed his deep affection for baseball, calling it 'the greatest gift,' and emphasized his need for fan support as he approaches his 38th birthday this month.  Reports in the media have suggested that Rodriguez's representatives have been in talks with the league to potentially reduce a possible 100-game suspension related to alleged performance-enhancing drug use. These allegations link Rodriguez to Biogenesis, a now-defunct anti-aging clinic in Florida, and its founder, Anthony Bosch. Rodriguez is among approximately 20 players who might face suspension due to this scandal. However, Rodriguez declined to comment on whether he would challenge a lengthy suspension or any other unfavorable decision from the Yankees or MLB. 'I'd prefer not to delve into those specifics right now. It's too early, and we should let the process unfold. That's my current focus,' Rodriguez explained.  Despite the swirling controversy, Rodriguez acknowledges the difficulty it poses for any athlete's focus. While speculations of a potentially career-ending suspension might be adding pressure – especially as he recovers from surgery – Rodriguez isn't explicitly admitting it. What Rodriguez does openly share is his desire to strengthen his connection with fans, particularly as he enters what could be the final phase of his career.  Often considered a top slugger or third baseman in baseball history, Rodriguez undeniably holds the record for the largest contract in American sports. Signed with the Yankees in 2007, it guarantees him $275 million over a decade. Critics, however, deem it the 'worst contract ever' due to his health issues and inconsistent performance. Today, Rodriguez concedes that his time in baseball is limited. Turning 38 on July 27, he is currently testing his recovery from January's hip surgery by playing in the minor leagues. The three-time MVP described the surgery as 'by far the toughest I've had to overcome.' 'Let's be realistic, I'm not a young player anymore. I'm not 28. I'm turning 38 this July. But I still believe I can contribute,' Rodriguez stated. 'I think I can be a significant hitter in the middle of the lineup, a strong right-handed bat for our team. But I'm at a different point in my career. Is it realistic to expect 40 or 50 home runs? Probably not. But can I perform like I did last night and repeat that several times a week? I believe so.' Rodriguez was referring to his home run in a recent minor league game where he went 2-for-4, raising hopes for a major league return possibly next week. He has a 5-for-28 batting record in the minors. 'It felt incredible,' he said about the home run. 'I haven't hit a ball like that in over a year.' He is determined to return to Yankee Stadium and is avoiding questions about potential setbacks. 'I'm choosing to focus on the positive,' Rodriguez said. 'I feel I owe the Yankee fans my best performance. I don't think they saw that last year. I addressed my issues, worked hard, and I'm eager to get back to New York and help my team win.' The Yankees' website indicates Rodriguez is expected to rejoin the team on Monday. Rodriguez also aims to improve his engagement with fans, admitting he limits one-on-one interviews. 'I've opted for a 'less is more' approach,' he said. 'And I've always tried to let my playing speak for itself. But recently, I've felt a need to connect more with my fan base. I think it's important, especially at this stage of my career. I want to communicate with them.' 'Firstly, I want to thank them for their unwavering support. It's been overwhelming and has motivated me,' he added. 'This has been a very challenging period, and I'm grateful for the chance to play baseball. I deeply love this game. My father played baseball. It's what I'm skilled at. It's my gift. God has given me this incredible gift, and it's what I love to do.' This year's hip surgery was his second, 'almost three times larger than my 2009 surgery,' he noted. 'It was extensive. They removed a significant portion of my left labrum and used five anchors,' he explained. Despite the injury, he maintains the enthusiasm of 'a kid playing out there,' he says. He wants to return to the Yankees to solidify his legacy as 'someone who loved the game, respected it, and valued teammates and competition,' he said. 'The one thing no one can ever take from me is my dedication and love for this game,' he concluded.  CNN's Adam Reiss contributed to this report.

Bara 2007 Yankees waliin kan mallatteessee, waggaa kudhaniif doolaara miiliyoona 275 akka argatu mirkaneessa. Qeebdonni garuu dhibee fayyaa fi raawwii taphaa isaa irratti hundaa’uun 'waliigaltee gadhee yeroo hundaa' jedhanii yaadu. Har’a, Rodriguez yeroon isaa baseball keessatti qabu daangeffamaa akka ta’e ni fudhata. Adoolessa 27 umuriin isaa 38 kan guutu yoo ta’u, yeroo ammaa baqaqsanii yaaluu muddaan isaa kan Amajjii keessa godhame irraa fayyuu isaa taphoota xixiqqaa keessatti taphachuun mirkaneeffachaa jira. Taphatichi yeroo sadii MVP kan ta’e baqaqsanii yaaluu kana 'baqaqsanii yaaluu hanga ammaatti na mudate keessaa isa cimaa' jedhee ibse. 'Dhugaa haa dubbannu, ani taphataa dargaggeessa hin taane. Umuriin koo 28 miti. Adoolessa kana keessa umuriin koo 38 ni guuta. Haa ta’u malee, ani ammas gumaachuu akka danda’u nan amana,' Rodriguez jedhe. 'Ani taphataa cimaa hiriira gidduu keessatti, rukuttaa cimaa mirgaaf garee keenyaaf ta’uu nan danda’a jedheen yaada. Haa ta’u malee, ani sadarkaa addaa tapha koo keessa jira. Rukkuttaa mana keessaa 40 ykn 50 eeguun dhugaa ta’aa? Tarii hin ta’u. Haa ta’u malee, akkan kaleessa raawwadhe sana raawwadhee torbanitti yeroo hedduu irra deebi’uu nan danda’aa? Nan amana.' Rodriguez rukkuttaa mana keessaa tapha xixiqqaa dhiheenya kana keessatti raawwate, yeroo inni 2-4 ta’ee, abdii deebi’ee gara liigii ol’aanaa dhufuuf torban dhufu keessa akka uumamuuf sababa kan ta’eef kan dubbachaa ture. Taphoota xixiqqaa keessatti rukuttaa 5-28 qaba. 'Baay’ee nama ajaa’ibsiisa ture,' jechuun rukkuttaa mana keessaa ilaalchisee dubbate. 'Ani waggaa tokkoo ol rukkuttaa akkanaa hin rukutne.' Gara Yankee Stadium deebi’uuf murteessaa kan ta’e yoo ta’u, gaaffiiwwan gufuuwwan uumamuuf danda’an ilaalchisee dhihaatan irraa fagaachaa jira. 'Ani miira gaarii irratti xiyyeeffachuufan filadha,' Rodriguez jedhe. 'Ani jaallattoota Yankee tapha koo isa gaarii akka argisiisu nan qaba jedheen yaada. Ani waggaa darbe isaan akka argisiisu hin yaadu. Rakkoolee koo sirreessee, cimaatti hojjedhee, gara New York deebi’ee garee koo akka mo’achiisuuf nan hawwa.' Websaayitiin Yankees akka ibsetti, Rodriguez Wiixata dhufu garee wajjin deebi’ee akka makamu eegama. Rodriguez jaallattoota isaa waliin walitti dhufeenya isaa fooyyessuuf yaadaa jira, gaaffii fi deebii dhuunfaa daangessuu isaa fudhateera. 'Ani mala 'xiqqaa caalaa' filadheera,' jedhe. 'Yeroo hundumaa taphni koo akka ofumaa dubbatu gochuufan yaaleera. Haa ta’u malee, dhiheenya kana, ani jaallattoota koo waliin dabalataan walitti dhufeenya uumuuf fedhii qaba. Keessumaa sadarkaa tapha koo kana keessatti barbaachisaa akka ta’e nan yaada. Isaan waliin dubbachuu nan barbaada.' 'Dursa, deeggarsa isaaniif galateeffachuu nan barbaada. Deeggarsi isaanii baay’ee nama ajaa’ibsiisaa kan ture yoo ta’u, na jajjabeessera,' jedhee itti dabale. 'Kun yeroo baay’ee rakkisaa kan ture yoo ta’u, ani carraa baseball taphachuuf argameef galateeffadha. Ani tapha kana baay’een jaaladha. Abbaan koo baseball taphataa ture. Wanti ani hojjechuu beeku isa kana. Kenni koo isa kana. Waaqayyo kennaa guddaa kana naaf kenneera, wanti ani hojjechuu jaaladhu isa kana.' Baqaqsanii yaaluun muddaan isaa kan bara kanaa isa lammaffaa yoo ta’u, 'baqaqsanii yaaluu bara 2009tti godhame caalaa yeroo sadii kan caalu' jedhe. 'Baay’ee bal’aa ture. Isaan labrum koo bitaa irraa baay’ee muraanii angoora shan keessa kaa’an,' jedhee ibse. Miidhama kanaafis, jaalala 'mucaa umuriin isaa waggaa 10 ta’ee kan achitti taphachaa jiru' qabaachuu isaa itti fufeera, jedha. Gara Yankees deebi’uun akka 'nama tapha kana jaallatuu fi nama tapha kana kabajuu fi nama taphattoota garee jaallatuu fi dorgommii jaallatu' ta’ee seenaa isaa cimsuu barbaada, jedhe. 'Wanti yoomiyyuu narraa fudhachuu hin dandeenye tokkichi carraaqqii ani godhuu fi jaalala tapha kanaaf qabuudha,' jechuun dubbii isaa xumure.  Adam Reiss kan CNN gabaasa kanaaf gumaacheera.
