article_content: Law enforcement officials are currently conducting a homicide investigation into the death of Odin Lloyd, whose body was discovered in close proximity to the residence of New England Patriots player Aaron Hernandez. Both authorities and Hernandez have remained silent regarding the details as of Friday. Hernandez has not made any public statements. His attorney released a statement acknowledging the ongoing investigation but refrained from confirming media reports about his client being questioned. Attorney Michael Fee stated that while it is widely reported that state police searched Hernandez's home as part of the investigation, neither he nor Hernandez will comment on the investigation's specifics until its conclusion, respecting the legal process. According to North Attleborough criminal clerk magistrate Mark Sturdy, three search warrants have been issued in connection to the case. These warrants are not yet public because the related files are still pending. Sturdy declined to comment on whether these warrants pertained to Hernandez's property. The deceased, 27-year-old Odin Lloyd, a semi-professional football player, was found less than a mile from Hernandez's large North Attleborough home. Police have been searching both Hernandez's home and nearby wooded areas for evidence this week. On Friday, two investigators in Massachusetts State Police jackets arrived at Hernandez's house, one carrying paperwork. They rang the doorbell, were let in by a woman, stayed for a brief period, and then departed without commenting on their activities. A law enforcement source revealed on Thursday that Lloyd's death was caused by a gunshot wound. Olivia Thibou, Lloyd's sister, told CNN that Lloyd and Hernandez were friends who had been together at a Boston nightclub the previous Friday night. She added that her brother was dating the sister of Hernandez's fiance but was unsure about when or how they initially met. Thibou expressed her disbelief and lack of knowledge regarding any conflicts between Hernandez and Lloyd, who was employed by a landscaping business. She described her brother as a friendly and fatherly figure to her daughter, unable to imagine why anyone would want to harm him. Ursula Ward, Lloyd's mother, described her son as a wonderful, family-oriented man who would not intentionally hurt anyone. Neighbors informed CNN that they viewed Hernandez, 23, as a quiet and respectful member of the community. Hernandez, currently recovering from a shoulder injury, was seen returning to his home on Wednesday afternoon wearing Patriots attire but did not acknowledge the media presence. He appeared to remain indoors or on his back deck for the remainder of the day. The ongoing investigation has already led to the termination of Hernandez's endorsement deal with CytoSport, effective immediately. Police were also observed searching through tall grass on the street situated between Hernandez's home and the location where Lloyd's body was discovered. CNN affiliate WCVB reported that nearly a dozen Massachusetts state police officers entered Hernandez's residence on Tuesday evening. Patriots spokesman Stacey James stated on Tuesday that the team was aware of the reports but would not comment due to the active investigation. Hernandez has played for the Patriots for three seasons, achieving an average of 58 catches per season and being selected for the Pro Bowl in his second year. ESPN reported that he signed a contract extension last year worth $40 million for the 2014-18 seasons. North Attleborough is approximately 15 miles from Gillette Stadium, the Patriots' home field. Simultaneous to the unfolding mystery in Massachusetts, Hernandez and his legal team were addressing a lawsuit in Miami. In this lawsuit, a man alleges that Hernandez shot him following an argument in a car after leaving a strip club. Court documents indicate that Alexander Bradley claims to have lost his right eye due to this February incident. Although initially dismissed on Monday due to a paperwork error, the case was refiled on Wednesday, according to court records. CNN's Mary Snow, Lawrence Crook, and Susan Candiotti contributed to this report.

article_content: A peaceful Wednesday afternoon in a suburban community near San Diego was dramatically disrupted when an older U.S. Marine Corps fighter plane went down, impacting three residences and igniting a fire. Its astonishing that nobody sustained injuries. The pilot of the AV-8B Harrier aircraft successfully ejected to safety just before the jet crashed into a house in Californias Imperial Valley, close to the border with Mexico, around 4:30 PM Pacific Time. The crash and resulting fire damaged three houses, with at least one being completely destroyed. Following the AV-8B Harrier jets impact in Imperial Valley, California, on Wednesday afternoon, fire broke out at least in one house. The impact caused damage to three homes in the residential area, including the total loss of one. Military investigators continued their work late into the night, collecting evidence to understand the reasons behind the $30 million fighter jets crash. This Harrier jet, from the 1980s, is famous for its vertical takeoff and landing capabilities, similar to a helicopter, due to its specialized thrust system. Each of these aircraft is valued at approximately $30 million. Residents informed the Imperial Valley Press that the impact felt like an earthquake. Smoke plumes were visible from a considerable distance, rising from the crash location in the neighborhood. Videos from the scene showed burning wreckage scattered across the streets and walkways of the residential area. The pilot was transported to a local hospital for medical assessment. Video footage captured him being assisted by bystanders, still with his parachute on, after landing in a parking area not far from where the jet crashed. Although the aircraft was stationed at the Third Marine Aircraft Wing in Miramar, it had taken off from Marine Corps Air Station Yuma in Arizona. This incident marks the second Harrier jet crash this month. Previously, on May 9th, another plane crashed around 40 miles outside of Phoenix, where the pilot also successfully ejected. The AV-8B Harrier, similar to the model shown, is well-known for its vertical takeoff and landing capabilities akin to a helicopter. Firefighters needed three hours to get the resulting fire under control. Visuals from the scene indicate that two homes sustained damage in the crash.

article_content: A 16-year-old schoolboy hanged himself after he was falsely branded a rapist by fellow pupils after pulling out of a playground drug dealing racket, an inquest heard. Tom Acton, 16, claimed that he was bullied into taking Ecstasy, amphetamines, and cocaine during school hours – yet when his mother, Gaynor, went to see staff at Poynton High School and Performing Arts College in Cheshire, which has 1,700 pupils, it was alleged that they refused to do anything about it. When she withdrew the boy from school, false rumors circulated alleging the innocent teenager had tied a girl to a tree and sexually assaulted her. Tom Acton three months before his suicide after being bullied by fellow pupils at Poynton High School, Cheshire. It resulted in groups of angry youths, sometimes up to 30, targeting him in the street and turning up at the family’s front door saying they wanted to kill him and ‘get rid of the vermin’. Tom began to self-harm with a blade and even carved the word ‘rapist’ into his leg. A friend had to stop him jumping from a railway bridge and he considered stepping into the path of heavy traffic. On October 31, days before he was due to testify at the trial of one of the bullies, Tom was found hanged in his bedroom by his father. Tom Acton's family home in Poynton, Cheshire, where he hanged himself in October 2013 after being called a rapist on Facebook. He died on November 2 at Stepping Hill Hospital. Tom’s organs were used to save the lives of eight people. The tragedy occurred just months after Tom gained nine GCSEs. At an inquest in Warrington, Gaynor Acton questioned why the school refused to accept that they had a problem with drugs – even though the suspected drug dealer's own mother gave staff a similar story. Mrs. Acton, 45, a former company director of a hydraulics firm, stated that her son was bullied into taking drugs at school and started in 2009. Tom Acton and his mother Gaynor. She believes that his school, Poynton High School and Performing Arts College in Cheshire, did not do enough to tackle drug taking among pupils. She added: ‘Tom was getting beat up a lot, being chased a lot, physically and mentally abused on a daily basis. ‘There were lots of police incidents recorded, school records. I tried working with the school to start with but the school wouldn't do anything about it, the next line was the police who again did nothing about it. ‘He was on Class A drugs that had been supplied to him from the lads inside of school, MDMA, amphetamines, cocaine, tablets. The only way we could get him to stop was to take him out of school; we took him out for three months.’ Asked by a coroner if he had explained to her why he took the drugs, Mrs Acton added: ‘Because if he didn't he would get bullied – if he did what everyone else did they would leave him alone. ‘Our doctor wrote to the school about peer pressure. But because he wasn't in school taking the drugs that's when they put it out on Facebook that he was a rapist.’ Tom Acton in his bedroom in December 2012. He was accused of rape, and groups of youths came to his door threatening to kill him. She said Tom had first started talking about suicidal thoughts in February 2013 and added: ‘There were lots of times when he said he was going to do something. He never showed me any of the self-harm. It was only what he had told me. He just couldn't sleep. ‘Tom couldn't have a girlfriend because he was 'a rapist'. That's how the rest of the people saw him in Poynton. He loved going out with girls before the rapist allegations.’ She also confessed to buying cannabis for Tom in an effort to help his recurring insomnia. Dr David Ward, Tom's GP, said: ‘He told me that he was the victim of bullying and other children had offered him drugs and cigarettes. He said he was being intimidated by a school pupil that was actively seeking him out and verbally and physically abusing him. ‘His mum alleged they were spreading rumours that he was a dirty rapist – he was struggling to concentrate and his mood was low. He described it as being dead inside. In July 2013, she said Tom left Poynton and began studying music production and sound technology at South Manchester College– but had never got over the false rape allegations.’ Tom attended Poynton High School and Performing Arts College in Cheshire leaving in July 2013. His mother Gaynor claims that Tom was forced to take Class A drugs at the school. ‘He was very excited about leaving school, he couldn't wait to get away from it,’ said his mother. ‘He was ecstatic that he was leaving school and he wouldn't have to go back. ‘The bullies didn't know how to get to him since he left school. ‘But as regards the rape allegations, he was very upset and he never actually got over that. It was always on his mind. ‘I want to know, why, when presented with physical evidence of drug taking in the school, the school refused to accept it had a problem and no action was taken.’ Holly Spicer, Tom's ex-girlfriend, told the hearing: ‘About one month or so before his death I was talking to him in the kitchen and he was talking about the rapist allegations. ‘He said he cut 'rapist' into his leg and also showed the marks on his wrist. He said he was sorry, I can't quite remember why. He spoke how he was beginning to believe the rumours himself.’ Tom was left bleeding after being attacked by bullies (left) Another friend Jake Dwight said that Tom had been feeling worried about testifying against teenager Thomas Greenwood, 18, who gave him a hiding whilst shouting: ‘If I see you, you are dead.’ Jake said: ‘I knew he was very worried about the upcoming case. ‘A couple of people sat at the gates waiting for him, his mother had to pick him up. Tom's father Paul, a mechanical electrical manager, was asked if Tom had been anxious about the court case and he said: ‘Not for himself. We had spoken about it. I had asked him during the week if he was still okay with it and he said he was a bit nervous.’ He added that he had become a ‘prisoner in his house’ for three years before his death because of the rumours. Trial: Tom Acton (left) was due to testify at the trial of Thomas Greenwood (right) in December 2013.  He admitted assaulting the teenager, but escaped jail as he was handed a 12-month community order and 100 hours of unpaid work. He said: ‘He was a very outgoing person, he made friends very easily. But because of the slander and the rumours that were spread he was isolated from everybody for the last three years of his life. ‘He never went around Poynton on his own, we had to pick him up and drop him off.’ Poynton High School headmaster David Waugh who was appointed after Tom left claimed school files showed the teenager had been both the ‘victim and the perpetrator’. He said there were, ‘various incidents where it was six of one and half a dozen of the other’. Mr Waugh said: ‘There were similar incidents where he had been bullied, where he had been verbally abused. ‘On a one to one basis Tom was exceptionally pleasant and engaged. His behaviour deteriorated in groups or class, or with a teacher he didn't get on with.’ Coroner Nicholas Rheinberg adjourned the inquest to call Sue Adamson, the former headmistress of Poynton, to answer Mrs Acton's claims.
translated_content: Mucaan barataa umrii waggaa 16 qabu, mana barumsaa keessatti daldala dawaa sammuu hadoochu keessaa erga ba'ee booda, barattoota kaaniin gudeeddatti himatamee of fannisee ajjeese, dhaddachi qorannaa dhaga'eera. Tom Acton, 16, akka inni mana barumsaa keessatti sa'aatii barnootaa keessatti Eekistaasii, amfeetamiinii, fi kookeyinii fudhachuuf doorsifamee himate – haa ta'u malee yeroo haati isaa, Gaynor, hojjettoota Mana Barumsaa Ol'aanaa fi Koleejjii Aartii Poynton kan Cheshii, kan barattoota 1,700 qabu bira deemte, isaan homaa gochuu didan jedhameera. Yeroo isheen mucaa sana mana barumsaatii baafte, oduu sobaa kan dargaggeessi balleessaa hin qabne intala tokko mukatti hidhee gudeedee jedhu tamsa'uu eegale. Tom Acton ji'oota sadii dura of ajjeesee booda barattoota mana barumsaa Poynton High School, Cheshire keessatti doorsifamee ture. Kunis dargaggoota dheekkaman gareewwan, yeroo tokko tokko hanga 30tti kan ga'an, daandiirratti isa doorsisuu fi balbala fuulduraa maatii bira dhufanii isa ajjeesuu fi ‘sanyii lafaa dhabamsiisuu’ akka barbaadan dubbachuutti geessise. Tom billaa fayyadamuun of miidhuu eegale, akkasumas jecha ‘gudeeddaa’ jedhu miilla isaa irratti caaqqeeffate. Michuun isaa tokko riilweeyyii irraa utaaluu irraa isa dhaabuu qabde, innis karaa konkolaataa ulfaataa keessa lixuu yaadee ture. Onkoloolessa 31, guyyoota muraasa dura dhaddacha namoota isa doorsisan keessaa tokko irratti ragaa baasuuf yeroo qabame, Tom kutaa ciisicha isaa keessatti abbaa isaatiin fannifamee argame. Mana maatii Tom Acton kan Poynton, Cheshire, bakka inni Onkoloolessa 2013 keessa Feysbuukirratti gudeeddaa jedhamee erga waamamee booda of fannise. Sadaasa 2 Hospitaala Stepping Hillitti du'e. Qaamni Tom lubbuu namoota saddeet oolchuuf fayyadame. Tragediin kun kan mudate ji'oota muraasa booda Tom GCSEs sagal argatee booda. Dhaddacha qorannaa Warringtonitti gaggeeffametti, Gaynor Acton maaliif manni barumsaa rakkoo dawaa sammuu hadoochu akka qaban fudhachuu didan gaafatte – haa ta'u malee haati daldalaa dawaa sammuu hadoochu jedhamee shakkamee mataan ishee hojjettootaaf seenaa walfakkaataa kennitee turte. Aadde Acton, 45, duraan daayrektara kompanii kan dhaabbata haayidirooliiksii, akka ilma ishee mana barumsaatti dawaa sammuu hadoochu fudhachuuf doorsifamee fi bara 2009 keessa eegale ibsite. Tom Acton fi haadha isaa Gaynor. Isheen manni barumsaa isaa, Poynton High School fi Koleejjiin Aartii Poynton kan Cheshii, barattoota keessatti dawaa sammuu hadoochu fudhachuu to'achuuf waan ga'aa hin gooneetti jettee amanti. Itti dabaluunis: ‘Tom baay'ee reebamaa ture, baay'ee ari'atamaa ture, guyyaa guyyaatti qaamaanis ta'e sammuun ni miidhamaa ture. ‘Galmeewwan poolisii baay'ee, galmeewwan mana barumsaa turan. Jalqaba mana barumsaatti hojjechuu yaaleera garuu manni barumsaa homaa gochuu hin barbaanne, itti aansee poolisii kan deebisee homaa hin goone ture. ‘Inni dawaa kutaa A kan mana barumsaa keessaa dargaggootaan dhihaateef, MDMA, amfeetamiinii, kookeyinii, pilaastikii irratti argama ture. Karaan isa dhaabsisuu dandeenyu tokkichi mana barumsaatii isa baasuu ture; ji'oota sadiif isa baafne.’ Koroneerri maaliif dawaa sammuu hadoochu akka fudhate isheetti akka ibse yoo gaafatamu Aadde Acton akkana jedhanii deebisan: ‘Sababni isaas yoo hin fudhanne ni doorsifama ture – yoo waan namni hundi godhu godhe isaan kophaa isa dhiisu turan. ‘Doktorri keenya dhiibbaa hiriyyaa ilaalchisee mana barumsaatti barreesseera. Garuu sababni isaas mana barumsaa keessa taa'ee dawaa sammuu hadoochu hin fudhanne yeroo sanatti Feysbuukirratti gudeeddaa akka ta'e baasanii labsan.’ Tom Acton kutaa ciisicha isaa keessa kan Muddee 2012. Inni gudeeddaatti himatamee gareewwan dargaggootaa balbala isaa fuuldura dhufanii isa ajjeesuuf doorsisuu turan. Isheen Tom jalqaba yaada of ajjeesuu kan dubbachuu eegale Guraandhala 2013 keessa akka ta'e fi itti dabaluunis: ‘Yeroo baay'ee waan tokko gochuuf akka deemu dubbachaa ture. Of miidhuu isaa homaa natti hin agarsiifne. Waan inni natti hime qofa ture. Inni rafu dadhabee ture. ‘Tom intala jaalallee qabaachuu hin danda'u sababni isaas innii 'gudeeddaa' dha. Namoonni Poynton keessa jiran haala kanaan isa ilaalu turan. Inni himannaan gudeeddaa dura intaloota waliin bahuu jaallataa ture.’ Isheen yeroo baay'ee hirribni dhabamuuf kannaabisii bituuf akka amanamtee himte. Doktar Daawit Ward, GP Tom, akkana jedhe: ‘Inni akka inni doorsisaa fi ijoollee birootiin dawaa sammuu hadoochu fi sigaaraa dhihaateef natti hime. Akka inni barataa mana barumsaa kan isa barbaadaa fi arrabsaanis ta'e qaamaan isa miidhuu eegalaniin sodaachifamaa akka ture himeera. ‘Haati isaa oduu sobaa gudeeddaa xuraa'aa akka ta'e tamsaasaa akka turan himatte – xiyyeeffannoo kennuu dadhabaa fi garaan isaa gad aanaa ture. Akka keessi isaa du'aa ta'eetti ibse. Adoolessa 2013, Tom Poynton gadhiisee oomisha muuziqaa fi teeknooloojii sagalee Koleejjii Kibbaa Maancheestaritti barachuu eegale – garuu himannaa gudeeddaa sobaa hin daganne.’ Tom Poynton High School fi Koleejjii Aartii Poynton kan Cheshii kan Adoolessa 2013 keessa gadhiise keessatti barate. Haati isaa Gaynor akka Tom mana barumsaatti dawaa Kutaa A fudhachuuf dirqisiifame himti. ‘Mana barumsaa gadhiisuutti baay'ee gammadee ture, achii fagaachuu hin danda'u ture,’ jette haati isaa. ‘Inni mana barumsaa gadhiisuutti baay'ee gammadde ture, deebi'ee achi deemuu hin barbaadu ture. ‘Namoonni isa doorsisan mana barumsaa gadhiisee eegalee akkamitti akka isa bira ga'an hin beekne. ‘Garuu ilaalcha himannaa gudeeddaa, baay'ee gaddee ture, dhugumatti kana hin daganne. Yeroo hunda yaada isaa keessa ture. ‘Ani beekuun barbaada, maaliif, yeroo ragaan qaamaa dawaa sammuu hadoochu mana barumsaa keessatti fudhachuu dhihaatu, manni barumsaa rakkoo akka qabu fudhachuu didanii fi tarkaanfiin homaa hin fudhatamne.’ Holly Spicer, intalli jaalallee Tom kan duraanii, dhaddachaatti akkana jette: ‘Naannoo ji'a tokko ykn isaa ol dura du'a isaa dura mana nyaataa keessatti isaa wajjin haasa'aa turee fi himannaa gudeeddaa ilaalchisee haasa'aa ture. ‘Inni ‘gudeeddaa’ miilla isaa irratti akka caaqqeeffate fi mallattoolee harka isaa irratti argisiise dubbate. Maaliif akka dhiifama gaafate sirriitti hin yaadadhu. Oduu sobaa mataa isaa amanuu akka eegale dubbate.’ Tom erga doorsiftotaan rukutamee dhiigaa dhangala'ee ture (bitaa) Michuun biraa Jake Dwight akka Tom ragaa dargaggeessa Thomas Greenwood, 18, kan yeroo isa rukutu ‘Yoo si arge, ati ni duuta’ jedhee iyye irratti ragaa baasuuf yaadda'aa turee dubbate. Jake akkana jedhe: ‘Dhaddacha dhufaa jiruuf baay'ee akka yaadda'aa ture nan beeka. ‘Namoonni muraasni balbala manaa eeggachaa taa'anii turan, haati isaa isa fudhachuu qabdi turte. Abbaan Tom Pool, hojjetaan makaanikaa elektirikaa, Tom dhaddachaaf dhiphachaa akka ture yoo gaafatamu akkana jedhe: ‘Mataa isaatiif miti. Isaa wajjin haasofnee jirra. Torban keessa yeroo tokko ammas tole akka ta'e gaafadhee ture innis akka inni xiqqoo sodaachaa jiru natti hime.’ Itti dabaluunis oduu sobaa sanaan kan ka'e du'a isaa dura waggoota sadiif ‘mana isaa keessatti hidhamaa’ ta'ee akka ture himeera. Dhaddacha: Tom Acton (bitaa) dhaddacha Thomas Greenwood (mirga) Muddee 2013 keessaatti ragaa baasuuf karoorfamee ture. Inni dargaggeessa sana miidhuu isaa ni amane, garuu hidhaa jalaa kan baqate yeroo ajaja hawaasaa ji'a 12 fi sa'aatii 100 hojii mindaa malee kennamuuf ture. Akkana jedhe: ‘Inni nama baay'ee namaan walitti makamuu jaallatu, michuu baay'ee salphaatti uummata. Garuu sababni isaas maqaa balleessaa fi oduu sobaa kan tamsa'ee waggoota sadan dhumaa jireenya isaa keessatti nama hundumaarraa adda bahee ture. ‘Inni Poynton keessa kophaa isaa hin naanna'u ture, nuti isa fudhannee isa buusuu qabna ture.’ Hoggantoonni Mana Barumsaa Ol'aanaa Poynton Deevid Waugh kan Tom erga deeme booda muudaman galmeen mana barumsaa dargaggeessi kun ‘miidhamaa fi miidhaa geessisaa’ akka ta'e argisiise himaniiru. Akkana jedhan, ‘Yeroo adda addaa kan ‘ja'a keessaa tokkoo fi walakkaa tokkoo’ ture ni jira.’ Obbo Waugh akkana jedhan: ‘Yeroo walfakkaataa kan inni doorsifamee, kan arrabsaan miidhamee ture ni jira. ‘Yeroo tokko tokkotti Tom baay'ee nama gammachiisaa fi kan hirmaatu ture. Amalli isaa garee ykn kutaa keessatti ykn barsiisaa isa hin jaallanne waliin ni badaa ture.’ Koroneer Nicholas Rheinberg Aadde Acton himannaa isaaniitiif deebii akka kennan Sue Adamson, hoggantuu mana barumsaa Poynton kan duraanii waamuuf dhaddacha qorannaa yeroof addaan kuteera.

article_content: It’s often said that ‘you can’t give what you don’t have.’ Think of every adult as a source of support, and each child as a growing flower.  Just like a garden needs care to grow well, kids need support to thrive. If adults are struggling with their own well-being, it’s harder for children to reach their potential. Data from the World Health Organization (WHO) indicates that almost one billion people globally face mental health challenges. This means mental health affects nearly everyone, directly or indirectly.  The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention report that nearly one in four children has a parent with a mental health condition.  Looking after our own mental health is crucial, alongside protecting young people.  Leaders today are in a great position to make a positive change.  Beyond just providing money, they can inspire others by prioritizing their own well-being. Mental health issues can affect anyone, including top leaders. By taking care of ourselves, we can better care for our children and build a better future. The COVID-19 pandemic’s impact needs more research, but WHO estimates a 25% rise in anxiety and depression worldwide after the pandemic’s first year.  This increase happened at the same time as major disruptions to mental health services, many of which continue today. Mental health, neurological, and substance use services were the most affected of all essential health services. Many countries also reported serious problems in critical mental health care, such as preventing suicide. While there has been some progress in making services more available, it’s still not consistent everywhere. Despite improvements, mental health problems still significantly affect communities, hurting well-being and economies.  Too many people, especially young people, still can’t get the mental health support they need. Mental health is a global issue, yet it’s still often stigmatized and underfunded in almost every country. Risks are especially high in crisis situations. To achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and improve futures for young people, we must prioritize mental health more. Recognizing this need, UNICEF, supported by the Z Zurich Foundation, started the Global Coalition for Youth Mental Health in 2022.  Today, strategic members of this Coalition include Jo Malone London, Spotify, Zurich Insurance Group, and Z Zurich Foundation. UNICEF estimates that one in seven kids and teens aged 10 to 19 live with a mental health issue.  Half of all mental health conditions start before age 14, and 75% by age 25.  Often, these cases aren’t found or treated.  Shockingly, countries on average spend less than 2% of their health budgets on mental health. Mental health is key to how we think, feel, and act.  We urgently need to put more money and effort into improving the mental health of young people to ensure a better future.  Supporting children and caregivers early is a smart investment for governments and donors.  Investing in mental health in childhood is much cheaper than dealing with the consequences later when these young people become adults. We can’t ignore mental health in children, teens, and caregivers. UNICEF works with many partners to help countries reach the SDGs. But these goals can’t be met by 2030 without addressing mental health.  Good mental health helps achieve all SDGs and fulfill countries’ legal duties to ensure children’s rights.  2023 is halfway to the 2030 SDG deadline. To mark this, UNICEF and private sector partners like Jo Malone London, Sony, and Spotify discussed SDG progress and how the private sector can boost youth mental health at a UN General Assembly (UNGA) event in September. The Global Coalition for Youth Mental Health is pushing for more investment and action on youth mental health throughout the year. It’s combining resources to address the mental health needs of children and young people worldwide. This includes inviting other organizations to join and help protect young people’s mental health globally. UNICEF is working closely with partners to protect and improve youth mental health – from a partnership with Spotify using music to support mental health, to working with Z Zurich Foundation to give teens and caregivers information and skills for mental well-being.  UNICEF is also collaborating with Jo Malone London and Sony to make real progress in fixing the serious gaps in mental health support where it’s most needed.  To learn more about the Global Coalition for Youth Mental Health and how to join, contact corporate-partnerships@unicef.org.
translated_content: 'Hin danda'amu waan hin qabne kennuu,' kan jedhu mammaaksi yeroo baay'ee dhaga'amu dha. Nama guddaa hunda akka madda deeggarsaa, daa'ima tokkoon tokkoo immoo akka daraaraa guddatuuutti yaadi. Akkuma iddoon biqiltuu guddina gaariif kunuunsa barbaadu, daa'immanis guddinaaf deeggarsa barbaadu. Namoonni gurguddoon dhiphina yoo qabaatan, daa'immaniif dandeettii isaanii guutuu argachuun baay'ee ulfaataa ta'a. Odeeffannoon Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaa (WHO) irraa argame akka mul'isutti, namoonni gara biliyoona tokkoo ta'an addunyaa maratti rakkoo fayyaa sammuu qabu. Kunis fayyaan sammuu kallattiidhaan ykn al kallattiidhaan nama hunda kan miidhu jechuudha.  Gabaasni Giddugala To'annaa fi Ittisa Dhibee irraa argame akka mul'isutti, daa'imman afur keessaa tokko kan haadha ykn abbaa rakkoo fayyaa sammuu qabu qaba. Fayyaa sammuu ofii kunuunsuun, daa'immanii fi dargaggoota eeguu wajjin walqabatee murteessaa dha.  Hoggantoonni har'aa jijjiirama gaarii fiduuf iddoo guddaa irra jiru.  Maallaqa kennuu qofa caalaa, ofiif dursa kennuudhaan warra kaan kakaasuu danda'u. Rakkoon fayyaa sammuu hoggantoota olaanoo dabalatee nama kamiyyuu miidhuu danda'a. Ofii keenya kunuunsuudhaan, daa'imman keenya caalaatti kunuunsuu fi fuuldura caalu ijaaruu dandeenya. Dhiibbaan dhibee COVID-19 qorannoo dabalataa barbaada, garuu WHOn bara jalqabaa dhibee kanaa booda dhiphinaa fi gaddaa addunyaa maratti %25 akka dabale tilmaameera.  Dabalataan kun yeroo tajaajilli fayyaa sammuu baay'ee gufatee ture, kan baay'een isaanii har'as itti fufanitti ta'e. Tajaajilli fayyaa sammuu, dhibee narvii, fi fayyadama wantoota adoochiyoon tajaajilawwan fayyaa murteessaa hundumaa keessaa kan baay'ee gufatan turan. Biyyoonni baay'een kunuunsa fayyaa sammuu murteessaa, kan akka of ajjeesuu ittisuu keessatti rakkoo cimaa akka qaban gabaasaniiru. Yeroo tajaajilawwan argamuu danda'an gochuuf tattaaffiin godhamee jirulleen, bakka hundatti walsimaa miti. Fooyya'iinsa jiraatuyyuu, rakkoon fayyaa sammuu hawaasa baay'ee miidhuu, fayyaa fi diinagdee miidhuu itti fufa.  Namoonni baay'een, keessumaa dargaggoonni, deeggarsa fayyaa sammuu isaan barbaachisu argachuu hin danda'an. Fayyaan sammuu dhimma addunyaa ti, garuu biyya hundatti kan salphifamuufi maallaqni xiqqaa itti ramadamu dha. Balaan keessattuu haala rakkisaa keessatti baay'ee cimaa dha. Galma Guddina Itti Fufiinsaa (SDGs) galmaan ga'uufi fuuldura dargaggootaaf fooyyessuuf, fayyaa sammuu caalaatti dursa kennuu qabna. Fedhii kana hubachuudhaan, UNICEF, deeggarsa Dhaabbata Z Zurichiin, Waldaa Addunyaa Fayyaa Sammuu Dargaggootaa bara 2022 keessa jalqabe.  Har'a, miseensonni tarsiimoo Waldaa kanaa keessaa Jo Malone London, Spotify, Zurich Insurance Group, fi Z Zurich Foundation ni argamu. UNICEF akka tilmaametti, daa'imman keessaa tokko fi umriin isaanii 10 hanga 19 ta'an rakkoo fayyaa sammuu wajjin jiraatu.  Rakkoon fayyaa sammuu walakkaa umrii 14 dura, %75 immoo umrii 25 dura jalqaba.  Yeroo baay'ee, dhimmoonni kun hin argaman ykn hin yaalamu.  Baay'ee nama ajaa'ibu, biyyoonni giddu galeessaan baajata fayyaa isaanii keessaa %2 fayyaa sammuutiif ramadu. Fayyaan sammuu karaa itti yaannu, itti dhaga'amnu, fi itti goonuuf furtuu dha.  Fuuldura caalu mirkaneessuuf, maallaqaafi tattaaffii caalaa fayyaa sammuu dargaggoota fooyyessuuf yeroo hatattamaa keessatti kennuu qabna.  Daa'immanii fi kunuunsitoota yeroo jalqabaatti deeggaruun mootummaafi deeggertootaaf invastimantii ogeessaa dha.  Fayyaa sammuu daa'imummaatti invast godhuun, yeroo dargaggoonni kun namoota gurguddoo ta'anitti rakkoo isaan mudatu furuu caalaa baay'ee gatii salphaa dha. Fayyaa sammuu daa'immanii, dargaggootaafi kunuunsitootaa dagachuu hin dandeenyu. UNICEF biyyoonni SDGs galmaan ga'uuf gargaaruuf dhaabbilee hojii hedduu wajjin hojjeta. Garuu galmoonni kun bara 2030tti fayyaa sammuu osoo hin furin galmaan gahuu hin danda'an.  Fayyaa sammuu gaarii guddisuun SDGs hundumaa galmaan ga'uufi dirqama seeraa addunyaa biyyoonni daa'imman mirga isaanii argachuu fi itti fayyadamuu danda'uuf qaban raawwachuu keessatti kaka'umsa dha.  Bara 2023tti, waqtii giddu galeessaa raawwii ajandaa 2030 SDGs ti. Kana yaadachuuf, UNICEF fi dhaabbileen hojii dhuunfaa kan akka Jo Malone London, Sony, fi Spotify UN General Assembly (UNGA)tti baatii Hagayyaa keessa adeemsa SDGs irratti godhamee fi karaa dhaabbileen dhuunfaa fayyaa sammuu dargaggootaa caalaatti guddisuu danda'an irratti mari'ataniiru. Waldaan Addunyaa Fayyaa Sammuu Dargaggootaa fayyaa sammuu dargaggootaaf invastimantii fi tarkaanfii caalaa bara guutuu keessatti gaafachaa jira. Fedhii fayyaa sammuu daa'immanii fi dargaggoota addunyaa maratti furuuf qabeenya walitti qabaa jira. Kunis dhaabbileen biroo akka makamaniifi fayyaa sammuu dargaggoota addunyaa maratti akka eegan afeeruu dabalata. UNICEF fayyaa sammuu dargaggoota eeguufi fooyyessuuf dhaabbilee hojii wajjin dhihoo hojjeta – waldaa Spotify muuziqaa fayyadamuun fayyaa sammuu deeggaru irraa kaasee hanga Dhaabbata Z Zurich wajjin hojjechuutti, dargaggootaafi kunuunsitootaaf odeeffannoo fi dandeettii fayyaa sammuu ofii fi kan walii kunuunsan kennuuf.  UNICEF Jo Malone London fi Sony wajjinis tajaajila fayyaa sammuu bakka baay'ee barbaachisutti fooyyessuuf hojjetaa jira.  Waldaa Addunyaa Fayyaa Sammuu Dargaggootaa fi akkamitti makamuu akka dandeessan dabalataan baruuf, corporate-partnerships@unicef.org quunnamaa.

article_content: A pair of hikers spent nearly an hour trapped on top of a flimsy wooden stile (a set of steps for crossing a fence or wall) after being cornered by two angry bulls. Jennifer O’Malley and her partner Dave Alden were walking in Altarnun, Cornwall, when the aggressive animals blocked their path. The couple sat on top of the stile for almost an hour before having to drag themselves through a hedge to safety. Scroll down for video. Jennifer O'Malley and her partner, Dave Alden, were hiking in Altarnun in Cornwall when they were cornered by two angry bulls. The couple climbed onto a flimsy wooden stile to stay out of the animals' reach where they were trapped for almost an hour. Mr Alden tried to run to safety in a nearby field but was butted back into the fence, suffering a painful cut to his wrist. The pair then decided to wait in the hope the menacing bulls would grow tired and wander off. But neither showed any sign of backing down, leaving the couple stuck for 45 minutes. They eventually escaped by crawling sideways through a thick hedge between the fields, scratching themselves in the process. Mr Alden filmed their ordeal on his mobile phone to warn others about the aggressive animals. The video shows the two bulls snorting and scraping the earth with their hooves, as if poised to charge. He says: 'So here we are on a public footpath. This is the stile in the middle. We’ve got this bull on this side and this bull on this side.' Mr Alden's wrist was injured when the bull butted him into a fence after he tried to run away. Terrified: Jennifer O'Malley said she'd never encountered anything like it and has now been put off walking. 'We’ve got this bull on this side and this bull on this side': The animals surrounded the couple on a public footpath. He then points the camera at his wrist to reveal a bloody gash, adding: 'I tried going on this side - this is what the bull gave me when he pushed me into the fence.' Ms O'Malley said afterwards that the couple had no choice but to claw their way through thick brambles to escape. She said: 'It was nearly impenetrable and we got scratched to bits but it was the only option we had. 'I’ve never encountered anything like it. article_content: A man filming a fire at a fertilizer plant in West, Texas, captured the terrifying moment a massive explosion ripped through the facility. This footage is among several videos documenting the sheer horror of the blast, which occurred around 7:50 p.m. local time on Wednesday. The explosion at the plant has resulted in approximately 15 fatalities and hundreds of injuries. Tragically, a nearby nursing home collapsed due to the force of the blast, trapping residents inside. Derrick Hurtt, a local resident, had stopped his car to observe the earlier fire at the plant. While recording the burning structure, a sudden event triggered a powerful explosion. Flames erupted skyward, violently shaking Hurtt's vehicle as he and his 12-year-old daughter, Khloey, desperately sought safety. Hurtt recounted the horrific scene, noting that many others were closer to the plant and vanished after the explosion. He described the blast lifting his truck and throwing him onto his daughter. Khloey cried out in pain and fear, repeatedly urging her father to flee, saying she couldn't hear. The initial video shows Hurtt calmly observing the fire from a distance of 250-300 yards, commenting on the wind direction. About 30 seconds into the recording, the explosion occurs, sending flames towards their car. Separate videos have emerged showing the plant engulfed in flames and the massive mushroom cloud that formed after the explosion. Another video captured a house ablaze in the aftermath. Shaken, Hurtt quickly reversed his car to escape. Khloey's panicked pleas to leave can be heard in the audio. In an interview on the Today show, Hurtt described the scene as 'horrific,' stating that people closer to the blast were 'nowhere to be seen' afterward. He mentioned his truck was lifted off the ground and that he landed on Khloey. Both he and Khloey experienced temporary hearing issues. Following the explosion, many West residents were on the streets, confused about what had happened. Paul Lannuier, another YouTube user, filmed the massive mushroom cloud. A police spokesperson reported that the explosion and subsequent fires leveled five blocks of homes. The casualty count is estimated at 15 deaths and 160 injuries. President Obama expressed his condolences and support for West, Texas, acknowledging the community's devastation and the loss of life. He thanked first responders and assured federal assistance through FEMA. Governor Rick Perry also tweeted his support and prayers. The explosion site, West, Texas, is located 20 miles north of Waco and 40 miles north of Crawford, where George W. Bush's ranch is situated. The town has a population of 2,600 and is 70 miles south of Dallas. Waco is mobilizing to aid West, with Baylor University holding a prayer service, collecting donations, and organizing volunteers. Students are also arranging blood drives to support local hospitals.

Although mechaphilia is an extremely unusual and rare behaviour, the sexual attraction to objects and mechanical equipment is not strictly seen as a mental health problem. The Diagnostic Statistical Manual (which acts like a physician’s recipe book for diagnosing health conditions) states that mechaphilia is a non-specific paraphilia, with a paraphilia being a type of sexual attraction or predilection that runs alongside 'conventional' sexual behaviours. Paraphilia are only seen to be viewed as such when the sexual feelings or behaviours become problematic, often leading to depression or anxiety within the individual, or when the behaviour itself (or the attempted avoidance of such behaviour) causes serious problems with day to day functioning. There are literally dozens of other forms of unusual paraphilia running from A-Z including Apotemnophilia (attraction to amputees) and Zoosadism (an attraction to seeing animals in pain). Some of these paraphilia are more psychiatrically concerning than others – especially if they involve the pleasure of witnessing or inflicting pain or suffering in other adults, children or animals, such as Anthropophagy – a pleasure derived from eating human flesh. In comparison then, mechaphilia (sometimes known specifically as autophilia, when an individual develops either sexual or emotional attachments to vehicles – most commonly cars) seems quite innocuous and harmless – with many mechaphiles explaining that they do not hurt anyone by their behaviours. Indeed Edward Smith has spoken quite openly, and at times graphically, about his behaviour, going to great lengths to point out that he has had relationships with humans before and that he is not homosexual, but that he just prefers cars. Ever since Fritz Lang’s Metropolis was released in 1927, some have been concerned that the sexualisation of robots – maschinenmensch as it was in the movie – could result in mecaphilia becoming a commonplace occurrence. Some mechaphiles may find only vehicles arousing, while some may find both humans and vehicles stimulating and can try to combine both of them into their sexual activities. What does seem quite common in many mechanophiles, of which approximately 85-90% are male, seems to be an extreme form of relationship avoidance and failed romances in early formative years. But that is also true for the 'normal' non-mechanaphile population too. While such romantic failures are part of many peoples’ growing up experiences, some find it just too painful and develop alternative feelings and emotions for other objects (even animals) that cannot hurt or reject in the way that humans possibly can. Although some mechaphiles do possess the insight to say that they found 'human relationships' too difficult or painful, just as many are often in denial about such difficulties in their pasts. Mechaphilia, like most other paraphilia, can best be viewed as the result of a disturbance in the psychosexual development, whereby healthy sexual and emotional feelings are subconsciously transferred to objects that are safer or less 'emotionally risky' than other people. If this occurs at a crucial time on the formative developmental period, the reward the mechaphile gets (sexual / emotional release without fear of rejection) can be quite powerful and addictive, which will reinforce future mecaphilic behaviours.

Mr. Smith akka inni konkolaataa 700 wajjin, akkasumas helikoopterootaa fi xiyyaarota wajjin saalqunnamtii raawwate boonee dubbateera, garuu amma Volkswagen Beetle adii 1969 Vanilla jedhamu kan inni ‘jaalala jireenya isaa’ jedhu wajjin qubatee jira. ‘Obboleeyyan koo akka godhanitti gonkumaa hin hirmaanne akkasumas halkan isaanii wajjin hin dabarsine.’ Amma, Volkswagen adii isaa Vanilla jaalallee isaa fi jaalala jireenya isaa akka ta’e dubbata. ‘Isheen dhugumatti addaa taatee jirti. Bara 1982tti isheen argadhe kanaafuu Mudde 23 irratti waggaa 30 ta’a,’ jedhe. Isaan lamaan yeroo Mr. Smith Volkswagen Beetle biraa Victoria jedhamu wajjin walitti dhufeenya keessa turetti ‘wal qunnaman’. Garuu yeroo Vanilla irratti ija isaa buuse, jaalalli yeroo jalqabaa ture. Akkana jedhe: ‘Isheen argachuu koo dura, yeroon Yelm keessa jiraadhu, ogeessi oofaa mana amantaa Jehovah’s Witness naannoo san jiraatu Beetle adii keessatti barreeffamoota raabsaa yeroo turanitti yeroo jalqabaaf isheen qunname. ‘Beetlee adii 1969 sun yeroo barreeffamoota isaanii raabsuuf dhaabatanitti, yeroo isaan haasa’anitti, ani ija koo ishee irraa kaasuun dadhabe.’ Waggaawwan booda, biitachuuf Beetlee adii walfakkaataa beeksisaan arge. Yeroo gara mana daldalaa konkolaataa deeme, lakkoofsi gabatee ishee kanuma akka ta’eefi isheen dhugumatti konkolaataa sanuma ta’uu isheetti baay’ee ajaa’ibsiifate. Amma ganama hundumaa Vanilla nagaa gaafata. ‘Walqunnamtii’ qabeenya isaa dhuunfaa irratti raawwatu, garuu bakka ummataatti akka hin argamne of eeggannoo godha. Mr. Smith Opal GT 1973, Cinnamon jedhamu, fi Ford Ranger Splash 1993, Ginger jedhamu wajjinillee walitti dhufeenya keessa jira, garuu Vanilla ‘baay’ee kan nama dhiisu’ fi hin hinaaftu. Konkolaataawwan lubbuu akka hin qabne akka hubatu yoo dubbatus, isaanitti miira cimaa qaba akkasumas dhugumatti walitti dhufeenya yeroo dheeraa keessa akka jiran amana. Konkolaataawwan isaa kan dhiqu namni isa qofa, kunis akkuma bishaaniin dhiqaa kennuufiiti, jedha. Wajjin haasa’uu, muuziqaa dhaggeeffachuu fi ‘hundumaa saabuunaan guutuu’ ni jaallata. ‘Ani “Edward, onnee kee keessatti akkasumas lubbuu kee keessatti isaan kun konkolaataawwan ta’uu isaanii ni beekta” – garuu yeroon harka koo keessatti isaan qabadhu humna isaan keessaa tokko tokko irraa dhufu nan dhagaha. ‘Dhiheenyaa kana umuriin koo yeroo dabalaa deemu, humnoonni saalqunnamtii tasgabbaa’aniiru. Sana booda, jaalalli baay’ee guddaan waggaa 32 booda waanti nu addaan baasu akka hin jiraanne nan barbaada.’ Miirri isaa baay’ee cimaa waan ta’eef rakkoon makaanikaa ykn gombifamuu Vanilla keessatti yoo uumame ‘baay’ee akka gaddamu’ dubbata. Sodaan isaa garmalee of eeggannoodhaan akka oofu, hamma hamma shakkiitti geessutti jechuudha. Yeroo tokko injineera makaanikaa hojii gadhee yeroo hojjetee Vanilla karaa dheeraa irra yeroo caccabse baay’ee aare. Makaanikoonni konkolaataawwan akka suphaniif yoo hayyamus, seera cimaa qaba: konkolaataawwan kan dhiqu namni isa qofa. ‘Ofii koo hojjechuu nan filadha,’ jedhe. ‘Akkuma bishaaniin dhiqaa kennuufiiti. Wajjin haasa’a, muuziqaa dhaggeeffadha, hundumaa saabuunaan guuta.’ Pirofeesar Kireeg Jaaksan, hogganaa saayikolojii Yuunivarsiitii Birmingihem Siitii, MailOnlinetti akkana jedhaniiru: Pirofeesar Kireeg Jaaksan mekaafiliyaan akka rakkoo fayyaa sammuutti garmalee akka hin ilaalamne dubbatan. Mekaafiliyaan baay’ee kan hin argamneefi kan hin baratamne dha, akkasumas mekaafiiloonni hawaasa keessatti hammam akka babal’ataniif baay’ee kan hin beekamne dha, garuu addunyaa maratti akka argamaniifi sababiin isaas aadaawwaniif kan adda hin taane fakkaata. Mekaafiliyaan gocha baay’ee kan hin baratamneefi kan hin argamne ta’us, miirri saalqunnamtii wantootaafi meeshaalee makaanikaatiif qabamu garmalee akka rakkoo fayyaa sammuutti hin ilaalamu. Maanuwaalli Istaatistaikaa Beekumsaa (kan akkuma kitaaba miilsaa fayyaa fayyaa argachuuf fayyaduutti kan hojjetu) mekaafiliyaan paarafiiliyaa adda hin taane, paarafiiliyaanis gosa miira saalqunnamtii ykn filannoo saalqunnamtii ‘aadaa’ wajjin wal qabatee deemu ta’uu isaa ibsa. Paarafiiliyaan akka kanaatti kan ilaalamu yeroo miirri saalqunnamtii ykn gochi saalqunnamtii rakkoo qabu ta’u, yeroo baay’ee dhiphina ykn yaaddoo nama dhuunfaa keessatti geessu, ykn gochi ofii isaa (ykn gocha sana irraa fagaachuuf yaaluun) rakkoolee cimaa hojii guyyaa guyyaa wajjin wal qabatan yeroo geessu qofa. Paarafiiliyaawwan hin baratamne A-Ztti kan deeman kanneen akka Apotemnophilia (miira qaama hir’uu hawwuu) fi Zoosadism (miira bineensota garmalee miidhamuu ilaaluu hawwuu) dabalatee hedduutu jira. Paarafiiliyaawwan kun tokko tokko kanneen biroo caalaa yaaddessaa dha – keessumaa yeroo gammachuun miidhaa ykn dhiphina namoota gurguddoo, ijoollee ykn bineensota biroo irratti raawwachuu ykn ilaaluu keessatti argamu, kanneen akka Antroopoofaagii – gammachuu foon namaa nyaachuu irraa argamu. Yeroo sana wal bira qabnee yoo ilaalle, mekaafiliyaan (yeroo tokko tokko addatti autofiiliyaa jedhamuun kan beekamu, yeroo nama dhuunfaa tokkoon miira saalqunnamtii ykn miira onnee konkolaataatti – yeroo baay’ee konkolaataatti – qabaatu) baay’ee kan miidhaa hin qabneefi kan hin balaa qabne fakkaata – mekaafiiloonni hedduun gocha isaaniitiin nama kamiyyuu akka hin miidhanne ibsaa wajjin. Dhugumatti Edward Smith waa’ee gocha isaa ifatti, akkasumas yeroo tokko tokko garmalee ifatti, dubbatee, walitti dhufeenya namaa wajjin duraan akka qabaateefi homoseeksuaalii akka hin taane, garuu konkolaataawwan qofa akka filatu ibsuuf baay’ee tattaaffateera. Erga fiilmiin Fritz Lang “Metropolis” jedhamu bara 1927tti gadhiifamee, tokko tokko saalqunnamtiin robootoota – maashinshmeensh akkuma fiilmii keessatti ture – mekaafiliyaan waanuma baramaa akka ta’u gochuu danda’a jedhanii yaadda’aniiru. Mekaafiiloonni tokko tokko konkolaataawwan qofa kan nama kakaasan yoo ta’u, tokko tokko immoo namaafi konkolaataawwan lamaanuu kan nama kakaasan ta’uu danda’u akkasumas lamaanuu gocha saalqunnamtii isaanii keessatti walitti makuuf yaaluu danda’u. Wanti mekaafiilota hedduu keessatti baay’ee baramaa fakkaatu, kanneen keessaa tilmaamaan %85-90 dhiira yoo ta’an, fageenya walitti dhufeenyaa garmalee fi jaalalli kufu bara guddinaa jalqabaa keessatti kan mudatu fakkaata. Garuu kun ummata ‘normal’ hin taane mekaafiilotaafis dhugaa dha. Yeroo kufuun jaalalaa akkanaa muuxannoo guddinaa namoota hedduu keessaa tokko yoo ta’e, tokko tokko baay’ee kan nama gaddisiisu ta’ee wantoota biroof (bineensotaafillee) miiraafi onnee filannoo kan hin miidhanne ykn akka nama danda’utti diduu hin dandeenyeef qabaatu. Mekaafiiloonni tokko tokko ‘walitti dhufeenya namaa’ baay’ee kan ulfaataa ykn kan nama gaddisiisu akka ta’e dubbachuuf hubannoo yoo qabaatanis, hedduun isaanii rakkoolee dabaroo isaanii keessatti akka jiran haaluu keessa jiru. Mekaafiliyaan, akkuma paarafiiliyaawwan biroo hedduu, bu’aa jeequmsa guddina saalqunnamtii keessatti uumamuutti, yeroo miirri saalqunnamtii fi onnee fayya qabeessa ta’e wantoota ykn namoota biroo ‘miira onneetiin balaa kan hin qabne’ caalaa gara wantootatti gara jabeenya malee kan ce’uutti ilaalamuu danda’a. Kun yeroo murteessaa guddinaa keessatti yoo uumame, badhaasni mekaafiila argatu (gammachuu saalqunnamtii / onnee sodaa diddaa malee) baay’ee cimaafi kan nama qabsiisu ta’uu danda’a, kunis gochawwan mekaafiilaa gara fuulduraatti kan cimsuudha.

article_content: Ukraine's Bureau of Investigation has charged lawmaker Oleksandr Dubinsky and other officials with high treason, for working with Russia to spread disinformation about Ukraine's government, create division between the U.S. and Ukraine, and thwart Ukraine's possible admission to the EU and NATO. Link to the article in The Kyiv Independent is here. One of the schemes alleged to have been directed by Russia was to push conspiracy theories involving Hunter Biden in the run-up to the 2020 election, in order to help Trump. Dubinsky and [former MP Andrii] Derkach pushed conspiracy theories that involved Hunter Biden, the son of U.S. President Joe Biden, who sat on the board of the Ukrainian gas company Burisma, as well as Mykola Zlochevskyi, the company's founder and a former minister under former pro-Russian President Viktor Yanukovych. They repeated the claims elsewhere as well. The allegations that either President Biden or his son were involved in unlawful actions associated with Burisma have been widely debunked. … The conspiracies then went viral in the U.S. in the leadup to the 2020 presidential election, fueled in part by a wider campaign among political opponents of Biden who sought to use his son's activities in Ukraine against him. Matt Tait, who writes about national security and cybersecurity (@pwnallthethings.bsky.social on BlueSky), breaks it down: More information is in a Politico article, link here.

article_content: By James Nye and Helen Pow. PUBLISHED: 02:14 EST, March 8, 2013 | UPDATED: 11:13 EST, March 8, 2013 A convicted sex offender has confessed to the rape and murder of his 17-year-old neighbor, telling reporters he 'lost control' and would 'take it back' if he could, in a shockingly honest press conference. Richard Hooten, 49, was charged on Wednesday with strangling Tara Willenborg to death as he raped her in her Clarksville, Indiana, apartment early Saturday morning. 'I just lost it in my head. I just lost control,' Hooten said on Thursday in front of scores of reporters at the Clark County Sheriff's Office. Wearing an orange prison jumpsuit, the man calmly described the events that led up to Willenborg's death. SCROLL DOWN FOR PRESS CONFERENCE Confession: Richard Hooten, 49, pictured, confessed on Thursday to the 'terrible crimes'. 'I left Rodeos with my friends and my girlfriend and I came back and (Willenborg) was sitting on the steps,' he said. 'I went into my apartment and came back out and she was still sitting out there. I asked if she wanted to hang out, so we went into her apartment and started hanging out and everything.' He said when she resisted him, he dragged her into her bedroom where he choked her as he raped her. He said he 'blocked out' her crying. 'I didn't realize how strongly I was really putting pressure on her. I was choking her,' he told reporters, according to Indystar.com. He said he tried to perform CPR on the lifeless teen, but it was too late, so he tied an apron around her neck to make it look like she'd killed herself. Tragic: The family of Tara Willenborg, pictured, are mourning the beautiful teen's tragic death in her Clarksville, Indiana, apartment. Family: The teen's family said in a statement, 'Our hearts are broken and our lives will never be the same.' Next, he said he went back to his apartment, which was across the hall, and packed some clothes before telling his girlfriend he had to be at work early. 'I was nervous, you know. I was trying to figure out what I was going to do because I just did a terrible crime,' he said. Yesterday, Hooten said the attack wasn't premeditated. 'I didn't really plan it. I went into her apartment. She was a pretty girl,' he said. 'I didn't know she was 17, I thought she was 19 or 20.' But according to Indystar.com, the man told police he knew he was going to rape her when he first saw her sitting on the stoop outside her apartment building. Calm: Hooten was calm as he told reporters exactly what happened on Saturday. Uncommon: Hooten, pictured, made his confession in front of reporters on Thursday at Clark County Sheriff's Office. Sorry: He apologized for what he did and said it wasn't planned, though he reportedly told police earlier that he knew he was going to rape the teen. Hooten, a sex offender who has been convicted of six violent felonies, is also charged with criminal deviate conduct, being a habitual offender, and abuse of a corpse. He said he wasn't on drugs or particularly drunk when the attack took place and didn't know whether the teen had been drinking. 'I'm just sorry for what happened. I wish I could take it back, you know,' he said to Willenborg's parents and fiancé. Willenborg was laid to rest Wednesday at Walnut Ridge Cemetery in Jeffersonville. She would have turned 18 on Sunday. Her family released a statement yesterday saying their lives will 'never be the same' and said they were 'relieved' Hooten was locked up. Life cut short: Willenborg, pictured, was laid to rest Wednesday at Walnut Ridge Cemetery in Jeffersonville. She would have turned 18 on Sunday. Tara Willenborg of Clarksville was sexually assaulted and murdered inside her Clarksville, Indiana, apartment on Saturday. 'The family would like to express our gratitude to everyone for their prayers in this terrible time,' they said. 'Our hearts are broken and our lives will never be the same. We are relieved that the murderer is behind bars where he cannot hurt anyone else, but nothing he can say or do will bring Tara back.' According to the newspaper, the pretty 17-year-old's family said they did not want to focus on the horrible way the teen died, 'but on the beautiful life she lived.' 'She brought kindness, humor, and peace wherever she went. We loved her with all our hearts, and we will miss her smile, her curls, and her cupcakes. We will miss her art, her humor, and her sense of style. Our hearts cannot yet imagine the future without her. Tara was our baby, and she always will be.' The 17-year-old was discovered dead inside the apartment she shared with her fiancé - they had only moved into the building in January. Willenborg's body was discovered by her fiancé Joshua Lewis when he returned from work on Saturday morning. Hooten was arrested walking near Willenborg's block after Lewis called 911 from a neighbor's apartment. Clark County coroner Terry Conway said on Tuesday the teen was strangled, and prosecutor Steven Smith said that the girl suffered a 'horrible death'. Willenborg's father said his daughter had just moved into the apartment in January with her fiancé. Sex offender: Hooten, 49, is a convicted sex offender. Police initially thought Hooten was working or visiting the apartment next door to Willenborg. 'They just had an acquaintance. I think they had just met recently,' said Darrell Rayborn of the Clarksville Police Department to Wave3.com. He said that Hooten aroused police suspicions when he loitered around outside of the apartment complex building. 'Officers found him walking. He sort of fit the description, and at that time they asked for his identity and ran a background check and noticed he had outstanding warrants,' said Rayborn. Hooten currently has a warrant for his arrest for failing to register as a sex offender. He also has prior convictions, including one for sexual battery in Indiana in 2009, and another in Georgia for aggravated sodomy and rape dating back to 1993. In addition, he had been wanted in Clark County for failing to register as a sex offender and failure to appear on a prior meth charge. The Reverend Jennifer Mills Knutsen said that Willenborg's parents are stunned by the loss of their spiritual daughter. 'They're dealing with shock and grief and horror and just trying to make sense of it all,' said Knutsen told WDRB.com earlier this week. 'In all of her thoughts and all of her actions, she always tried to follow the path of peace.' 'That's part of what makes her death so hard for all of us who loved her.' 'We want to remember her not just for the horrible ending of her life but for the rich fullness and the love that she gave to us while she was alive.' article_content: In Minnesota, homeowner Byron Smith was convicted of premeditated murder for fatally shooting two teenagers during a break-in at his Little Falls home on Thanksgiving 2012. Smith, 65, claimed self-defense due to past burglaries and fear. Prosecutors argued he intentionally ambushed the teens in his basement.  Seventeen-year-old Nick Brady and 18-year-old Haile Kifer were shot nine times by Smith.  Jurors quickly convicted Smith on multiple first and second-degree murder counts. The teens' mothers showed emotion at the verdict; Smith did not. His attorney plans to appeal. The case ignited debate in Minnesota, especially Little Falls, about homeowner self-defense limits. Minnesota law allows deadly force to prevent felonies at home if actions are "reasonable." Audio recordings revealed Smith shooting the teens and calling them "vermin." Prosecutors showed Smith prepared for the break-in, moving his truck and arming himself in the basement, recording the shootings. Smith waited a day to report it. The teens were unarmed, but Smith's defense claimed fear of weapons.  Though excluded from trial, the teens were linked to a prior burglary. Smith's defense cited his fear from previous burglaries. The case raises complex questions about home defense and justifiable force limits.

article_content: PARIS, France -- Argentina concluded their impressive World Cup campaign in a similar fashion to its beginning, stunning host nation France on their home ground with a sensational performance to claim the tournament's bronze medal with a 34-10 victory. Argentina players celebrate a try during their stunning 34-10 victory over France. This victory, secured thanks to Pumas tries by Felipe Contepomi and Omar Hasan in the first half, and Federico Martin Aramburu, Ignacio Corleto, and Contepomi again in the second, evoked memories of their surprising 17-12 win against France in the tournament's opening match. Their earlier triumph at Stade de France was founded on strong defense, and while they displayed similar resilience at Parc des Princes, their attacking prowess was more prominent in this match. The tries by Aramburu and Corleto were particularly memorable, contributing to Argentina's record-breaking success against the French. Contepomi added three conversions and a penalty, accumulating a personal score of 19 points for the night, while France managed only a try from Clement Poitrenaud -- converted by Lionel Beauxis -- and a penalty from Jean-Baptiste Elissalde. It was a disappointing finale for their head coach Bernard Laporte -- who is now transitioning to a role in the French government -- but departing Pumas coach Marcelo Loffreda, heading to Leicester Tigers, was jubilant at the final whistle. With less pressure, the host team seemed uninhibited, appearing more energized than Argentina throughout the match. Indeed, they dominated much of a fiery opening 40 minutes, yet somehow found themselves trailing 17-3 at halftime. France, playing with the flair reminiscent of their past teams, had a try disallowed in the 10th minute when Imanol Harinordoquy was deemed to have made a forward pass before Elissalde grounded the ball. Players like Yannick Nyanga and Christophe Dominici were finding gaps in the Pumas defense, but their dominance in the opening 20 minutes only yielded a penalty from Elissalde, awarded for Patricio Albacete's hands in the ruck. Their lack of scoring efficiency was harshly punished by Argentina, who scored two tries within four minutes around the half-hour mark. Contepomi, who had equalized with a 22nd-minute penalty, was the first to score a try, running onto a delayed pass from Agustin Pichot to push himself over in the left corner. Then, after Juan Martin Hernandez hit a drop goal against the post, the Pumas regained possession, and prop Hasan was at the bottom of a pile of players to ground the ball. The try required confirmation from the video referee, and Contepomi -- as he did after his own try -- added the conversion for a 17-3 lead. This scoreline was unexpected, considering France's dominance in early possession. Even when positioned near Argentina's try line in the last five minutes of the first half, the hosts could not breach their opponents' stubborn defense. Nyanga came closest to scoring in the second minute of injury time but dropped the ball while attempting to ground it. The half concluded with yellow cards for Juan Martin Fernandez Lobbe and Raphael Ibanez following another heated exchange, but the start of the second half was engagingly open. France needed to score first to make it competitive, but they were surprised by Aramburu's try in the 53rd minute. It was a remarkable try: Aurelien Rougerie's chip-and-chase was caught by Felipe Contepomi before Corleto embarked on an impressive 50-yard run. The ball was quickly passed to the right -- through Manuel Contepomi and Hernandez -- to Aramburu, who evaded Dominici to score. Contepomi missed the conversion, and French supporters were already whistling as their team trailed 22-3. Sebastien Chabal was substituted in for the final 20 minutes and was almost immediately tackled late by Juan Manuel Leguizamon. This earned the London Irish flanker a yellow card, but Argentina capitalized on their numerical disadvantage by scoring a sensational fourth try. From turnover ball, Horacio Agulla was released clear on the left wing. His inside pass was taken by Corleto, and similarly to the tournament's opening game, he outpaced the covering defense to score in the corner. The try France deserved arrived in the 69th minute, with Poitrenaud, who had been recalled to the team, scoring in the left corner after an initial break by Harinordoquy. However, the night belonged to the Pumas, and Contepomi finalized the score with his second try of the night with three minutes remaining, adding further disappointment for the French. translated_content: PAARIS, Faraansaay -- Argantina duula Waancaa Addunyaa isaanii haala jalqabsiisaniin xumuraniiru, biyya keessatti Faransaay raajuudhaan tapha ajaa'ibsiisaa taphachuudhaan meedaaliyaa bironsii dorgommichaa 34-10n injifachuudhaan argatan. Taphattoonni Argantinaa injifannoo isaanii kan ajaa'ibsiisaa ta'e 34-10n Faransaay irratti argatan yeroo goolii galchan ni kabaju. Injifannoon kun, kan goolii Pumas kan Felipe Contepomi fi Omar Hasan yeroo walakkaa jalqabaatti galchaniin, akkasumas Federico Martin Aramburu, Ignacio Corleto, fi Contepomi yeroo walakkaa lammaffaatti deebi'anii galchaniin mirkanaa'e, injifannoo rifaasisaa 17-12 kan Ameerikaa Kibbaa dorgommichaa galgala jalqabaa irratti argatan yaadachiise. Injifannoon isaanii kan duraa kan Isteedii Faraansaay ittisa cimaa irratti hundaa'ee ture, yeroo isaan jabeenya wal fakkaataa kan Paark des Pirinsesitti agarsiisan, humna isaanii kan haleellaa yeroo kana caalaatti muldhate. Gooliin Aramburu fi Corletoon caalaatti kan yaadatamuu qaban yoo ta'an, injifannoo Argantinaa kan Faransaay irratti galmeessan gumaachaniiru. Contepomi jijjiirraa sadii fi adabbii tokko dabaluudhaan, galgala sanaaf dhuunfaatti qabxii 19 argate, yeroo Faransaay goolii tokko qofa Clement Poitrenaud irraa -- kan Lionel Beauxis jijjiire -- fi adabbii Jean-Baptiste Elissalde irraa galchuu danda'an. Kun xumura gaddisiisaa kan leenjisaa isaanii Bernard Laporte -- kan amma gara hojii mootummaa Faraansaayitti ce'aa jiru -- ture, garuu leenjisaan Pumas kan deemaa jiru Marcelo Loffreda, gara Layicester Tigers imalaa kan jiru, xumura xururuutti gammachuudhaan guutamee ture. Dhiibbaan yeroo hir'atu, gareen keessummeessaa kan hin daangeffamne fakkaatu, guutummaa taphichaa keessatti Argantina caalaa humna horatanii kan muldhatan fakkaatu. Dhugumatti, isaan daqiiqaa 40 jalqabaa kan gubataa ta'e keessaa baay'ee isaanii kan too'atan yoo ta'u, haata'u malee haala kamiinuu yeroo walakkaa 17-3n duubatti hafuu isaanii argatan. Faransaay, haala taphoota biyya sanaa kan durii fakkaatuun kubbaa darbataa kan turan, gooliin isaanii daqiiqaa 10ffaa irratti yeroo Imanol Harinordoquy darbii gara fuulduraatti godhe jedhamee yeroo Elissalde lafa kaa'uu dura itti murteeffame ni dhiifame. Taphattoonni akka Yannick Nyanga fi Christophe Dominici ittisa Pumas keessatti qaawwa argachaa turan, garuu injifannoo isaanii kan daqiiqaa 20 jalqabaa irraa kan argatan adabbii Elissalde tokko qofa ture, kan harka Patricio Albacete rakkisaa keessatti argamuuf kenname. Dandeettii goolii galchuu dhabuun isaanii Argantinaan garmalee adabame, isaan daqiiqaa afur keessatti yeroo walakkaa naannoo goolii lama galchan. Contepomi, kan adabbii daqiiqaa 22ffaa irratti wal qixxeessan, taphataa jalqabaa kan goolii galche ture, darbii boodaatiin kan Agustin Pichot irratti dhufee gara cinaacha bitaatti of dhiibee ce'uuf. Sana booda, erga Juan Martin Hernandez goolii lafaa irraa gara utubaa rukutee booda, Pumas deebisanii qabeenya argataniiru, fi deetaan Hasan isa lafa kaa'uuf qaama taphattootaa kan walitti kuufame jala ture. Gooliin kun mirkaneessa abbaa murtee viidiyoo barbaade, fi Contepomi -- akkuma goolii isaa booda godhe -- jijjiirraa gooliif 17-3n dabale. Qabxiin kun kan hin eegamne ture, yeroo injifannoo jalqabaa Faransaay ilaalamu. Yeroo isaan daqiiqaa shan xumuraa yeroo walakkaa jalqabaa keessatti daangaa goolii Argantinaa naannoo yeroo qubatanitti illee, gareen keessummeessaa ittisa jabaa morkattoota isaanii cabsuu hin dandeenye. Nyanga daqiiqaa lammaffaa yeroo dabalataa keessatti goolii galchuuf baay'ee dhihaatee ture garuu yeroo lafa kaa'uuf yaalu kubbaa ni kuffise. Walakkaan xumurame kaardiiwwan keelloo kan Juan Martin Fernandez Lobbe fi Raphael Ibanez walitti bu'iinsa gubataa biroo booda argataniin, garuu jalqabbiin yeroo walakkaa lammaffaa haala nama hawatuun banaa ture. Faransaay tapha dorgomaa taasisuuf jalqaba goolii galchuu barbaachisa ture garuu isaan goolii Aramburu daqiiqaa 53ffaa irratti galcheen rifataniiru. Goolii ajaa'ibsiisaa ture: chip-and-chase kan Aurelien Rougerie kan Felipe Contepomi qabate dura Corletoon fiiguu km 50 kan nama ajaa'ibu jalqabe. Kubbaan gara mirgaatti dafee darbee -- Manuel Contepomi fi Hernandez keessa darbee -- gara Aramburu, kan Dominici jalaa miliqee goolii galchuuf. Contepomi jijjiirraa goolii ni dhiise, fi deggertoonni Faransaay yeroo gareen isaanii 22-3n duubatti hafe ni xururuu jalqabaniiru. Sebastien Chabal daqiiqaa 20 xumuraaf bakka bu'ee galee fi yeroo gabaabaa keessatti Juan Manuel Leguizamon biraan boodatti dhiibamee lafa bu'e. Kun kaardii keelloo kan taphataa London Irish argamsiise, garuu Argantina hir'ina lakkoofsa isaanii fayyadamuu dhaan goolii afraffaa kan ajaa'ibsiisaa ta'e galchuu danda'aniiru. Kubbaa jijjiirraa irraa, Horacio Agulla cinaacha bitaa irratti bilisaan gadhiifame. Darbiin isaa kan keessaa Corletoon fudhatame, fi haaluma tapha dorgommichaa kan jalqabaa fakkaatuun, ittisa duukaa bu'aa kan caalu daraan saffisaa ta'uudhaan gara cinaachaatti utaalchisee goolii galche. Gooliin Faransaay kan isaan barbaadan daqiiqaa 69ffaa irratti dhufe, Poitrenaud, kan gara gareetti deebi'ee waamame, cinaacha bitaatti goolii kan galche yeroo jalqaba Harinordoquy cabse booda. Haata'u malee, galgalli kan Pumas ture, fi Contepomi goolii isaa lammaffaa kan galgala sanaa daqiiqaa sadii hafanitti xumuruudhaan Faransaay caalaatti gaddisiisuuf dabalate. E-mail gara firaatti .

article_content: Scientists suggest a potential pill to treat or even prevent type 2 diabetes may soon be developed. A study conducted on diabetic mice revealed that a naturally occurring compound in the body successfully restored their blood sugar metabolism to normal levels. Researchers believe this compound could be taken daily, similar to a vitamin, to prevent the development of type 2 diabetes. Type 2 diabetes affects over two million people in Britain and is associated with lifestyle factors. The research findings are significant for the UK, where at least 2.5 million individuals are affected by this condition. The compound, known as nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), is crucial for cellular energy utilization. In the US, scientists normalized blood sugar levels in diabetic mice by injecting them with NMN. These injections also reduced elevated cholesterol and triglyceride levels in the blood. Researchers are now exploring methods to administer NMN to mice through drinking water. Dr Shin-ichiro Imai, the study leader from Washington University School of Medicine in St Louis, stated their desire to launch a pilot human study once a human-grade NMN is available. Risk factors for type 2 diabetes include having two or more of the listed factors, prompting a recommendation to consult a GP for a blood test. Classic warning signs of diabetes are often related to complications, so awareness of these signs is important. Type 2 diabetes, the most common form, is linked to unhealthy lifestyles. US scientists induced diabetes in young, healthy mice by feeding them a high-fat diet, which resulted in reduced levels of NAD, a molecule essential for energy conversion in cells. NAD, derived from NMN, activates SIRT1, a protein promoting healthy metabolism. Direct administration of NAD is too toxic, but scientists successfully increased NAD levels in mice by injecting NMN. After NMN treatment, mice showed significantly improved glucose responses. Female mice, in particular, regained normal glucose transport from blood to tissues. Male mice also showed improvement, though not complete normalization, possibly due to hormonal differences. Dr Jun Yoshino, a co-author from Washington University, expressed excitement about NMN’s substantial impact compared to other compounds and the promising nature of NMN being naturally produced by the body for human translation. In older mice, about 15% on a normal diet developed diabetes, and their glucose response improved with just one NMN injection, without adverse effects on healthy older mice. Few older female mice developed diabetes unless on a high-fat diet, but NMN injections normalized glucose tolerance in affected females. Dr Kathryn Mills from the Washington University team added that NMN also completely reversed and normalized cholesterol, triglyceride, and free fatty acid levels. A separate study found that sufficient vitamin D levels are linked to a lower risk of type 2 diabetes. Researchers at Helmholtz Zentrum Munchen in Germany suggested vitamin D’s anti-inflammatory effects as a possible reason. Dr Barbara Thorand, the study author, noted potential vitamin D deficiency in winter due to lack of sunlight and suggested that improving public vitamin D intake could reduce diabetes risk, pending further studies. Vitamin D is found in oily fish, eggs, and milk products. The vitamin D study results are to be published in the journal Diabetes Care.
translated_content: Saayintistoonni qoricha dhukkuba sukkaaraa gosa 2ffaa fayyisuu ykn ittisuu danda’u dhiyootti oomishamuu akka danda’u ni eeru. Qorannoon hantuutota sukkaara qaban irratti gaggeeffame kompaawundii uumamaan qaama keessatti oomishamu tokko metaboliizimii sukkaara dhiigaa isaanii gara idileetti akka deebise argisiiseera. Qorattoonni kompaawundichi akka vaayitaaminii guyyaatti fudhatamuun dhukkubni kun akka hin babal’anne gochuu danda’a jedhanii amanu. Dhukkubni sukkaaraa gosa 2ffaa Biriiteen keessatti namoota miiliyoona lamaa ol ta’an kan qabu yoo ta’u, jireenya haaraa wajjin walqabata. Argannoon qorannoo kanaa UK keessatti bakka namoonni miiliyoona 2.5 ol ta’an dhukkuba kanaan qabamanitti dhiibbaa guddaa qaba. Kompaawundichi, nicootinamide moonoonukile’ootaayidii (NMN) jedhamuun beekamu, humna seelii fayyadamuuf gargaaru keessatti gahee murteessaa qaba. USAtti, saayintistoonni hantuutota sukkaara qaban keessatti NMN isaanitti waraabuudhaan sadarkaa sukkaara dhiigaa isaanii gara idileetti deebisaniiru. Waraabawwan kun akkasumas sadarkaa kolestroolii fi trigerisaayidiin dhiiga keessatti ol ka’an ni hir’isaniiru. Qorattoonni amma karaa NMN hantuutotaaf bishaan dhugaatiin kennan irratti hojjechaa jiru. Doktar Shiin-iichiroo Imaa’ii, hogganaan qorannichaa Yuunivarsiitii Waashingitan Iskuul Oof Meedisiinii kan Seent Loo’iis irraa, NMN sadarkaa namaaf ta’u argannaan qorannoo xiyyaaraa nama irratti jalqabuu akka barbaadan ibsan. Wantoota balaaf saaxilan dhukkuba sukkaaraa gosa 2ffaaf kanneen armaan gadii keessaa lama ykn isaa ol yoo qabaattan, qorannoof GP keessanitti dafaa dhihaadhaa. Mallattooleen akeekkachiisaa dhukkuba sukkaaraa yeroo baay’ee rakkoolee wajjin kan walqabatan waan ta’eef, mallattoolee kana hubachuun barbaachisaadha. Dhukkubni sukkaaraa gosa 2ffaa, gosti dhukkuba kanaa baay’inaan argamu, jireenya haaraa fayyaa hin qabne wajjin walqabata. Saayintistoonni USA hantuutota xixiqqoo fi fayya qabeeyyii nyaata cooma guddaa qabu kennuudhaan dhukkuba sukkaaraa itti fidan, kunis sadarkaa NAD, molakiyuulii humna nutrientii irraa argamsiisuu fi gara seeliin fayyadamuu danda’utti jijjiiru kan hir’isu ta’ee argameera. NAD, kan NMN irraa argamu, SIRT1 kan hojjechiisu yoo ta’u, pirootiinii metaboliizimii fayya qabeessa ta’e kan guddusuudha. Kenniinsi NAD kallattiin kennamu baay’ee summaa’aa ta’us, saayintistoonni NMN hantuutota keessatti waraabuudhaan sadarkaa NAD milkaa’inaan ol kaasuun danda’aniiru. Yaala NMN booda, hantuutonni deebii gilukoosii baay’ee fooyya’aa ta’e argisiisaniiru. Keessumaa hantuutonni dhalaa, dandeettiin isaanii gilukoosii dhiiga irraa gara qaamaa fi unkaalee keessatti dabarsuu gara idileetti deebi’ee argameera. Hantuutonni kormaa akkasumas fooyya’iinsa argisiisaniiru, garuu guutummaatti gara idileetti hin deebine, kunis dhiibbaa hoormoonii wajjin walqabatee ta’uu danda’a jedhameera. Doktar Juun Yooshiinoo, barreessaa qorannichaa Yuunivarsiitii Waashingitan irraa, dhiibbaa NMN kompaawundoota biroo wajjin yoo wal bira qabamee ilaalamu baay’ee guddaa ta’uu fi NMN uumamaan qaama keessatti oomishamuu isaa ilaalcha keessa galchuudhaan gara namaatti jijjiiruun isaa abdii kan kennu ta’uu isaa ibsaniiru. Hantuutota dulloomoo keessatti, dhibbeentaan 15 kan ta’an kormaa fayya qabeessa ta’an nyaata idilee yoo nyaatan dhukkuba sukkaaraa ni qabaatu, deebiin gilukoosii isaaniis waraabuu NMN tokko qofaan fooyya’ee argameera, kunis hantuutota dulloomoo fayya qaban irratti dhiibbaa hamaa kan hin qabne ta’uu isaa agarsiiseera. article_content: A 19-year-old Texas man, Jacob Lavoro, is facing a possible life sentence for producing brownies laced with marijuana and hash oil. He is accused of selling the brownies for $25 and faces felony charges carrying penalties from five years to life in prison. Lavoro appeared at a Williamson County courthouse near Austin, Texas, on Wednesday for his second hearing since his April arrest. His attorney, Jack Holmes, informed reporters and supporters outside the courthouse that new lab evidence should lead to reduced charges. Lab results indicated only 2.5 grams of THC, marijuana’s psychoactive component, in the brownies. Authorities also mentioned a separate jar containing 145 grams of hash oil. In Colorado, where recreational marijuana is legal, edible products must be easily divided into 10-milligram THC servings, roughly equivalent to a medium-sized joint. Holmes argued that the test results do not warrant severe punishment but expressed doubt about receiving leniency. Despite Austin’s liberal environment within conservative Texas, Williamson County is known for its strict law and order approach, which faced national scrutiny in 2011 after the exoneration of a wrongly convicted man after 25 years in prison. During Wednesday’s court appearance with State District Judge Stacey Mathews, Lavoro, who is accused of making and selling the marijuana brownies, stated, ‘I’m scared. Very scared. I’m 19 years old and still have a whole life ahead of me. Please consider this.’ Lavoro’s supporters rallied outside the Williamson County Justice Center on Wednesday afternoon. Supporters of pot legalization have gathered 243,000 signatures supporting Lavoro’s case. First District Attorney Mark Brunner dismissed Holmes’ statements as ‘grandstanding’ and clarified that prosecutors are not seeking a life sentence. His office offered Lavoro a plea deal for a lesser felony with no jail time if he avoids further legal issues. Holmes rejected the plea deal, fearing overly strict probation terms. Brunner stated that the county is not making a statement on the war on drugs and that defendants risk trial outcomes when they decline plea bargains. ‘If this were just a college kid experimenting with a small amount of pot and brownies in an Easy-Bake Oven, it would be different,’ Brunner said. ‘However, this man was allegedly attempting to run a business.’ Hash oil is a controlled substance with stricter state penalties than marijuana, containing higher THC concentrations and categorized with amphetamines and ecstasy. Holmes anticipates Lavoro’s formal indictment later this month. Judge Mathews scheduled a crucial September hearing where Holmes plans to argue for the dismissal of charges based on the legality of the search of Lavoro’s apartment.

article_content: A weather system in the western Caribbean caused significant disruptions on Friday. In Jamaica, approximately 14,000 homes and businesses lost electricity because of strong rains that toppled trees, damaged power lines, and triggered landslides.  Emergency services in Jamaica rescued at least two dozen individuals from rising floodwaters in the southeastern part of the island, according to the Jamaican Defense Force. Tragically, Haiti was also severely affected by the downpours. Haiti's Civil Protection Agency informed the Associated Press that two people in the western Grand’Anse region died after being caught in floodwaters. Meteorologists had initially suggested the weather system might strengthen into a tropical cyclone. However, by Friday evening, they revised their forecast, stating that this development was unlikely as the disturbance weakened and dissipated near eastern Cuba. The U.S. National Hurricane Center in Miami cautioned that even though the system had weakened, there remained a danger of severe rainfall leading to rapid flash floods and mudslides throughout the weekend in southeastern Cuba and Hispaniola, the island shared by Haiti and the Dominican Republic. For ongoing coverage of climate issues, please visit: https://apnews.com/hub/climate-and-environment
